## Anthropic IPO Could Set Record
Anthropic officially unveiled details of its IPO to the public yesterday, setting up an offering that could value the AI company at [up to $2 trillion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO2zAMhU8jbwpkKv1lDxq6eEvXjgYtUzFbRTIk2kFuX7hDL9DtIwh8eO_9fMwP5MT5-QNf5CWWOdO7JRKhOmOWrZadA--lBayfDVMqb6IZDHzp3mhwMwbhk-a-W30kArId-d6N1ozOfINu8zEYpH6I98G6AcE4DOSCDdEaG2lcOvaXrjfgemPNfbzRsLoxuGF0FB0GUHdDK0upt1-Fs2wU06ecVG-hvLrkN5G9KftdwaRgyp-9NLleCqZLrGDqzcUXLUfjTK0pmP6105ETNR1L1Usq4fdyNKGqeS9aNhQdypFWfWI6SCPrJ2MWjaJBS-WUuGQFU1f9ur-vs305dTfPF3L6G1D-b9bTw58AAAD__130jeI), topping SpaceX's June debut as the largest public offering ever. Shares will trade on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. The company behind the Claude AI models took in $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier. It also reported an [$80.7 billion loss](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ_G7rAAn41dUKS57k-b0iJ4MRthFsGeT3776CLlCf5uik-jme_X1_blMGE-froTLAfaMrxbAmaom8scKxX0WKh5V-_oUqI3wKalnoWSQpvNecYLNtXvNgBoGHuwyqyjXI2cdB-tV2ZdJjXPcgnKKD-FMI37si5hmkE-TI_2U6ekNkqO8rEOsOxm9WZZDQTjvO4eEnZkqsMfwswRQrrpgjp4OvtkI3Np3fij089OPwNmlz0Mt4tEH6LTTwYfMyU67k4_XWX0CT7p_z9RXr8T-nSLgAmawEKiVGoFPL-ayMSYD9G4Uj5EhQvyC8RR6c1RuLyL07WGF4hWIO8fVI1qkUaNyxD5TH21e3ljSthm0z3kcTpM_8bz95RfVv8NAAD__6sKmgU), about $72 billion of which was attributable to accounting charges tied to financing deals. Anthropic has committed more than $540 billion to data centers and chip leases over the next decade. The filing also runs more than 90 pages of risk warnings, including that advanced AI could pose "catastrophic or existential [risks to humanity](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp8GOwxeHZGCYjYTu9lmiy0NgaveWQQDzLi-_cYt_hf46y85-c75_ZyehjyF5afZUJc5TgGP7LEUTJMJZU1xJ0t7zNakczXexwNxAgE9bwQHORlb6INTUzk9IwK2FepGqlYoKW5QrdqgmrvezSh72d8QenUbXGNBdSAGaIaK9IVrBMhGtKJTNQ5OKisHJXGWxgLrBDoqMdWvSKGsOPszfjDVNm6V12spe2btncHIYDyOo95yuDYGIwb-zgzGLQY8GYwLBkzGMxi_5HjmtEce38VTwMwN8czxb0kmJkfBpJMnyn8uikn8foelfz1a1o7RkmPt48dVD4_8C9NeJe32g7yn3EvWiWUz5P_fLN-L-9HwLwAA__97W4_v)." Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are leading the offering, with share count and pricing to be set in the coming weeks. Wall Street's target has a range from the top estimate of $2 trillion down to about $1.5 trillion amid jitters over AI spending.
## Halloween Costs Hit a Scary High
Americans are on track to spend a [record $13.5 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO5CAQBdDT4AwLyl5jBwSbOOtNN7RoKJoaYWMB08i3H3mkOcFkJZX0v97__9gehiIdr39mR1192g5sJWKtmDdz1JDTSZbOVKzJVzAxpoa4gYCJS8FBbcZWeuMmO6c9IuDQoZZqGcSixB_ogobhOc0DTta7yYzojB8FgnR-tlLISXak7zgpQEkxiHHpcXZqsWpeFHplLLBRoKOacv-R6KgBfbzSG3Nv095FHWo9Cxv-MlgZrK213j7Lzbj_DNb7ZLDadJTPHXPh3ljkN4gw8x_TwW0qtfAaqPALTeYBMxbewsVg7bJ2Z6MYqUyKjeK1G4rf_fV3q701fAUAAP__SMOEjg) on Halloween this year, the National Retail Federation reported, about $400 million more than last year and $1.9 billion more than in 2024. Candy is the sharpest squeeze. Prices for candy and chewing gum are [up 7.7% over the year](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUD1urDAQPo3pQOPBi6Fw8Rp3-9qUyJjx4sgwyDiLuH1EpJwg1Uzx_X88x6eLKW6v_24lUwKPG51HolIoj24rS-Y9-rjz4V2-FpcSn0QjAna1hBr16HyJbxplNZtAhNRWZKQeWhg0PLBaTDu5duok9tMEQU5Aj0GjemDnoJv6MFXR3HISUEtoQQ0N9bMevO4HTUE7j0IBzbFwbj45bmWhkC5-U248r1UySyn7Idp_Aq1Ae55n83W4wrO7boBAexTOl0C78kb3DcyzQHu7CrQS7l8JtEt8LZTrPUdPRx0417-Ft9q7bb65AyrZKQUAWqCtspn3M6YUj04LBa_VxfQTq_xtzLfB7wAAAP__HDyGqQ), more than double the rise in overall consumer prices, and shoppers are still expected to spend $4.1 billion on treats. Much of that is a lagging effect from cocoa, along with increased packaging costs. Candy makers are still working through cocoa beans bought during last year's price spike, and one analysis found [Hershey's seasonal peanut butter cups](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGupCAYBeCnwQ6Dv45IQbGN3Wy7pfmF35FZBALMGN_-Zm5yn-D2J-fkO__uyx2dd-HxFw_SdYtLoLN4qpXygqHuOSZnXIrFYL529D6eRAsIGHknOMgFTXVvWrrG6o0IqG9Id1L1Qklxg2bXhiY1gR0VCjLrME5yFcOkLG3QrzisjdOfuk6A7EQvBtXSZKUyclKSNokG2CDIuhpz-4wu1J02f8U35dbEo_F6rzUV1v9hMDOYz_NsyytRPjD_p_rhfHIM5keOhvLFa6ZgC7dYkcH8YwrcYLAXT9kZKvz5OhLvbrznTdY2nc57V0bJBvE40Pnv6fq7w94avgIAAP__yXOCfA) jumped 23% and Ferrero lifted chocolate packs nearly 19%. The average shopper now expects to [spend $115.14](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuxCAUBNDT4M4WfLBZFxRp3G3alNYPfBYSDBZGa_n20UbKCdKPRvPm477eMaaYH--4kWm-rJnOI1FrVFfMLdSyRxv3clisV8CUykm0AoepF7wHvaJt8Umr6JzxRECyIyP0LPms-QhdMGJEx0m62Xs1WTFKshMJYZ37dNIp6KJ51QkOWnDJ1TzQzenZ6tusyWu0wBQnF1upw1eJuQXy6SpPqoMtW5dMaG0_mHxjsDBYfMyYLQ0XhlJeCQYL2ZLLdjFYsLZoEx0Mlj9M7h8lZ-xfQuoD2e_-xJSo9eImlIJRiiG0LXXVuP2MKcVj0kzxx4Yx_U5o_zvuaeAnAAD__2dUhC8) on the holiday, and nearly half said they started buying in September or earlier to spread the cost out.
## Map: Where States Get Their Taxes
A new [state-by-state map](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCngc7IGGKbwsXfpMvfXok2Zon3ZDCyN_jy9qfkFa6eTzPSfN3mG1Ck_fEfNnS8pnnHWiIyY55h55DTQZ6OVDzkV4AYU0WclVRa9FIoM4NnOnHu28WtiAqHFl1vpkFORl5UG5yyMA13be92tRLsMmp10fdFSw0Al0G35N51vVSml4Mcpw7tYiZv7GRwNeBVM0pciFPuvhPtHHCNr3Ri7nza2ugC81Ga4V-jro261lq7k8oTooeDGCIVfsN3FDCjQPBBFAbGIhh-RMYT9ycKnzYsYs0f2ma3HJVipKJNM8rHBhQ_e_y3l06nfgMAAP__x5B-YA) shows where all 50 states get their tax dollars, using 2024 federal finance data, and the mix changes sharply at the state line. Property taxes are the biggest source in about half the states, according to the Census Bureau [survey behind the numbers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFyhCAUANDTYKcDH5WloEhjt2lTOl_8KhkEB1iZvX0muUIu8Ir39Zyf6LwL-yeeZMoW50A1eyqF0oyhHClezrorZovpfaD3sRLNwGFsBW9BzWiLu2kWzWo2IiDZkBFKS64VH6A5jEYpueo1qmFZBhC0WMHVKHBdlsc4yMaZX05wUIJL3uuOHqvSVj20ok2hBdZzWl2JqfuOLpSDNv-ON6XOxrPx5ijlykx-MJgYTLXWzlLIr9zt8WYwXSnuCc_c5le66Z0ZTHu8280FDJZyd5TTN8msV3Xeuzwq1vP9ROf_-PK_lNvATwAAAP__bv94Jw). New Hampshire leans hardest at 64.3%, since it has no general sales tax and no tax on wages. Florida and Texas, which also skip the income tax, rely on sales and property taxes, which together bring in about three-quarters of Florida's collections. Oil and gas states like North Dakota and Wyoming get a big chunk from [energy taxes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb_GdCB7gNgULl5Dl9duiUb2OHg1wcjMhuTvV1lpv2CrW91zpPNxXa6YOW-3_3gnL6ksG50HkwjVBTdZa9lzyHs5AtbXiszlJFpAw6U1ugW7YJD8oMU00ScioL4hb-zU68nqEZrVj0OIJvWG7MUl43CMOqZBj-B654yFJvs3zmiwRvd6mDpy0U7BuslSshhADZpillK7z5I3WSnxqzyodqHcG_aryH6o_p-CWcEs-Ezla4souWxdqTcFc0RBBTMyK5gPQaHfbbkE5Fbw2YbCTOH9OhTMTfVxPzNzPi5WDfp2x8w_QvlbpoeH7wAAAP__Uy59RA) instead, and Oregon, with no sales tax, leans on income taxes. Two families with the same income and house can pay very different bills depending on which side of a state line they live on. [See your state here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCngc7IGGKbwsXfpMvfXok2Zon3ZDCyN_jy9qfkFa6eTzPSfN3mG1Ck_fEfNnS8pnnHWiIyY55h55DTQZ6OVDzkV4AYU0WclVRa9FIoM4NnOnHu28WtiAqHFl1vpkFORl5UG5yyMA13be92tRLsMmp10fdFSw0Al0G35N51vVSml4Mcpw7tYiZv7GRwNeBVM0pciFPuvhPtHHCNr3Ri7nza2ugC81Ga4V-jro261lq7k8oTooeDGCIVfsN3FDCjQPBBFAbGIhh-RMYT9ycKnzYsYs0f2ma3HJVipKJNM8rHBhQ_e_y3l06nfgMAAP__x5B-YA).

The four words he wore on his wrist every day | | | |
---
Peter,
---
Charlie said it best in the days leading up to President Trump's victory in 2024: _" I don't care about polls. __ __I don 't care about betting markets. __ __I don 't care about vibes. __ _ **_I care about how many ballots are in the box. _**_ __If we turnout, we win. __ _**_Do the work. " _** Do the work... Charlie knew there was no easy route to saving our country. He knew there were no shortcuts to victory. He wore a red band on his wrist every day -- a reminder of what it would take -- that read, _**" Be Better. Work Harder." **_ It wasn't just for motivation. Charlie lived by those four words, and he expected every one of us at Turning Point to live by them too. In fact, the standards that Charlie built this movement on still hang on the walls inside our headquarters:

Within the margin of error. **And just as Charlie said... when it 's that close, only one thing matters: How. Many. Ballots. Are. In. The. Box. ** That's why our ballot chasing teams are working around the clock in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire to beat the Communist Left this November.

subject: 7 days
body:
We need just $18k for final cable - please chip in. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fd9590a747fe/7-days-and-a-wake-up-6757682?e=5bb5efcda7)

# Seven Days.
Dear friend, In just seven days, Maryland will be going to the polls on Election Day and deciding whether they will vote for higher taxes, more fees, extreme structural deficits and higher electric bills, or for common sense relief and a stable and prosperous state.

We are now just $18,000 away from our immediate goal for the final cable TV purchase. I have given a matching fund of that amount in order to ensure we cross the finish line strong. But I need your help to match this amount and help me pay for the ads. Thank you to so many who are joining us in this fight.

Remember the Maryland 400. They, the "Old Line," saved General Washington's Army just over a month after the Declaration of Independence was signed, allowing through heroic attack the escape of the entire American Army after being surrounded at the Battle of Long Island.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/5V_D4TIO1dO?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
[Click Here to help us buy Cable TV Ads to Fight for Maryland](https://us.list-manage.com/MbaFbpBqswS?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

Now in the same spirit of our Maryland 400 - we must stop the disastrous agenda of Absentee Governor Wes Moore. He does not care for you, our children or the future of our State - for him it is all about national appearances and running for president. Consider how he's left Maryland behind:
* highest electric bills in the nation
* second worst economy in the nation
* one of two states with a massive structural deficit
* raised property taxes by valuation increase of 26% last year - more on its way unless we replace him
* $200+ car registration fees
* Key Bridge - not built and not under contract
* Purple Line - doubled in cost to $10 billion and no service yet
* Red Line - a lot of money and not even broken ground
* Triple Crown - excluded from the Thoroughbred Racing
* A-10 Fighter Wing - gone to Michigan Gov. Whitmer
* Commanders - leaving
* Guinness - closed
* Triple A bond rating - gone
* $5 billion Gov Hogan surplus - gone and now we are $3 billion in structural deficit
* 300+ days out of state - nearly a year of his term - running for president

Help me stop him here in Maryland and save our State and nation from his reckless, continued tax and spend policies making us one of the worst economies in the Nation - second worst to be exact.

[Will you chip in to help me reach our Cable TV purchase goal tonight? $176, or in remembrance of our brave Maryland 400, will you donate $400, or even $1776](https://us.list-manage.com/ZB7cHSwcaLN?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)?

The election turnout is currently on par or just about 10% under the Hogan 2018 turnout - a great indicator for us as so many independents and swing democrats are fed up like you with the direction of the state! Wes Moore is losing. With your help we will win.

Thank you.

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Candidate for Governor of Maryland

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor, Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

## Texas Sues OpenAI
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton [sued OpenAI and its CEO](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAQRp9GMyzAHyQg2MRsNt3QaqFRqlAs6Bln3n7LuY9w8-5T53z_HvMDQgzH-hd2NPT2aT7wKhGJMM-EbyjliSWdeEDIa3vBQWWBWXI5MMGZVDNYCi-cO6idWbjTokYjlG65HvUo6s3oxXE1Wmu1H1vnvNW8d4OUtlNeC9XXwdw4waUSgsteN61fFHrULUA_qq6tOo4uUMoNbfiV8vGTXpgbm_Y6mo3oLFX7p5JTJafruhqf3nLY0rNQOu6jSk53VyWn7zu7o9hPFbtBzG5A60msgEf6MBsh7IVBjLiiYxvkne3hSLnU2bjzCjGGMqiq4-sOIX496Lf7vYz8HwAA__-PhYkm), Sam Altman, on Friday, accusing the ChatGPT maker of deceiving Texans about its chatbot's safety and failing to protect children. The [67-page lawsuit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAMhp8mbEGJEyAZMtzC1ltvRC6YEimQirilffsTvUe4xbJk6fP__T-X4YIxxe32jSsFfs152OgoiZhpH5heWMqDSr7ThnG_mQM3LlccQEErtZLQDThyfNJgsZrCVU1eVxR0543yzjtdLaG1U-Nab60iB25uvGubFhWMoK0aratiOHFaQae1gsbXZr52NJM3iI3rrBFW0RQ57zUv9Ak1p3d-0l6Pea1SWJjvRZgvAb2A_jiO-o1LzudVQH8KCegf58Cd45joXD8cedrJPz1ZcJWYeMVNamcseLCuXnhN1R6m-xFTiqXthFW3FWP6_Ob_dvYM8BsAAP__iDqAsA), filed in Collin County, says ChatGPT makes "tips on eating disorders, self-harm and mass murder" available to children without age checks or parental consent. It relies on the state's consumer protection law and a 2023 law on kids' online safety. The suit points to [at least eight people](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdF75b69x4SIN3U2bEg14DJYMRszsz337iM0jpB7N0Tnfn-_xG0ot-_IbNoz8zm3c8UUVmfEcGd9A9EBqB-5QzsW-YGeaYDTKfEmtpPEjzFyeODroUpxUCrrDqH2wKvSh190ae-8yYnbGee9snr1KGlzIAezk7h67Ei-cVsZrrcw93GyePGYMFuDee2eFU5gKt_PGK36kcv1pTzxvc9u6Glfmg4T9JcwgzLC2lmrZ8ToKM1xsYQathBk-vxIWecCb2y6vNvkvThL8kJxX4OVgmR9YMUl6lLkkJAl7khsQSVpbYzxJmKE7YzpepdZCX144tWxQ6seI_3fJZzR_AwAA__9QmYpu) who used ChatGPT before committing violent acts. It asks a judge to ban minors from using ChatGPT, require outside approval of new models, and set penalties of up to $10,000 per violation. Derek, this
election comes down to a simple decision:

Do we want to elect someone who will respect the will of the people, or
someone who will obey the will of the President?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/20977?t=1002&akid=811%2E245147%2EY0aHWe ]I’ll explain what I mean in a moment, but if you already know where I’m

no secret that Pennsylvania is a crucial electoral battleground state —
not just in this year’s midterms, but in 2028’s presidential election as
well.

Pennsylvania’s next Governor will have the solemn duty of certifying
Pennsylvania’s vote in the 2028 presidential election — and
Derek, we need
to elect a Governor who will respect it.

protect the voices and votes of Pennsylvanians. And when Donald Trump and
his far-right allies tried to silence those voices and throw out our votes

She praised the January 6th rioters as “patriots”. She can’t name a single
issue where she disagrees with Donald Trump. And when 2028 rolls around,
she’ll do whatever Donald Trump tells her to.

subject: It’s been an incredible journey
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9804%2E582294%2E9Cln_C ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9804%2E582294%2E9Cln_C ]Chris Pappas for Senate

It’s Chris.

It's been an incredible journey since we launched our campaign 18 months
ago, and now everything we’ve worked toward is within reach. We have just
one week until the polls close, the votes are tallied, and we learn who
New Hampshire’s next Senator will be.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_1.w50oPZ&refcode=em20261027-1&t=1003&akid=9804%2E582294%2E9Cln_C ]If you’re already on board and ready to help us reach our final,
critical $2 million end-of-month fundraising goal, can I count on you to
rush a $5 contribution before Saturday?

Our final end-of-month deadline is on Saturday. This is our final chance
to build the resources we need to stay competitive with the MAGA
billionaires and national Republican groups propping up John Sununu’s
campaign.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_1.w50oPZ&refcode=em20261027-1&t=1004&akid=9804%2E582294%2E9Cln_C ]This is the culmination of everything we have built together — a
movement of people who believe in a freer, fairer future. We set a goal to
raise $2 million before Saturday’s deadline. Can you chip in
$5 before it’s too late?

The GOP and the MAGA billionaires backing John Sununu are determined to
flip this seat red. That’s why they are spending more than $66 million to
try and buy this seat — and they’re counting on us falling short of our
goal.

With Election Day just one week away, every hour counts now. And every
dollar has to stretch even further in these final moments.

That’s why I’m reaching out one last time to ask for your support. Not
because it’s a nice-to-have, but because hitting this goal is the only way
we’ll be able to win this race.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_1.w50oPZ&refcode=em20261027-1&t=1005&akid=9804%2E582294%2E9Cln_C ]Please, will you chip in what
you can before our final deadline to help us reach our $2 million
fundraising goal and keep us on track to win on November 3rd?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261027_1.w50oPZ&amount=5&refcode=em20261027-1&t=1024&akid=9804%2E582294%2E9Cln_C ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

Dear Advocate for Life, Imagine a young woman who has just discovered she's pregnant. She's frightened, overwhelmed, and unsure of what to do next. Maybe she hasn't told anyone. Maybe someone in her life is pressuring her to have an abortion. But what if, before making that decision, she had the opportunity to see her baby for the very first time? **That's the life-changing opportunity your gift to PreBorn! can help provide.** Through our PreBorn! Network Clinics across America, mothers facing unexpected pregnancies receive free ultrasounds, compassionate care, and the opportunity to hear the gospel of Jesus Christ. name: Bernie Sanders
subject: I am, once again, asking for your financial support ...
body:
[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Chris Deluzio for PA

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.AE9VfX&refcode=em261027-bernie&refcode2=158.42639.TJoSIb&t=1002&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Pittsburgh Post Gazette: State, federal lawmakers rally in support of
Allegheny County paid parental leave policy -- Allegheny County Executive
Sara Innamorato was joined by Democratic state and federal officials
Thursday in issuing a call for the county health board to pass
Innamorato’s proposed paid parental leave policy next week. The county
health board is scheduled to vote on the proposal — which would provide 12
weeks of paid parental leave for eligible county residents — on Monday. If
passed, the measure will go before County Council next month. Innamorato,
who is due to give birth to her first child this fall, was joined by
lawmakers including U.S. Reps. Chris Deluzio and Summer Lee, state Reps.
La’Tasha Mayes and Aerion Abney, and state Sen. Nick Pisciottano, at a
press conference at the Western Pennsylvania Diaper Bank in Point Breeze.
“These are elected representatives who don’t just talk about being
pro-family, but are actually willing to step up, to spend political
capital, and to take the action necessary to get pro-family policies
across the finish line,” Innamorato said. Monday’s vote will follow months
of debate on the issue. The policy that goes before the health board has
been revised since the original proposal that would have provided 18 weeks
of paid parental leave. Brought for public comment in May, the initial
plan received mixed reactions from hundreds of county residents who
submitted comments to local officials. In response, the Board of Health
announced sweeping changes to the policy earlier this month, reducing the
length of paid leave to 12 weeks and implementing a small-business cap
that would exempt businesses with fewer than 15 employees. “The county
listened to feedback on the paid parental leave policy and we made several
adjustments,” Innamorato said. More than a dozen states have enacted
mandatory paid parental leave policies, while another nine have adopted
voluntary paid parental leave systems that allow the benefit in the
private insurance market. Pennsylvania has no statewide parental leave
policy, although Sen. Pisciottano, D-Allegheny, introduced legislation in
March that would provide 12 weeks of paid leave to employees who have
worked their jobs for at least a year. That bill was referred to committee
upon introduction but has yet to receive a committee vote or hearing.
Meanwhile, the state House passed a paid family and medical leave bill in
March. That legislation has since stalled in the Republican-controlled
Senate. In June, the Pennsylvania Senate Labor and Industry Committee
voted 9-2 in a bipartisan move to pass the Family Care Act, which would
establish a paid family and medical leave program for up to 20 weeks for
eligible workers for the birth of a child or a serious personal medical
issue. Sponsor Devlin Robinson, R-Allegheny, said the act would fund the
program through employee payroll contributions and be administered by the
state Department of Labor and Industry. The legislation has yet to go to
the Senate floor for a vote. A federal paid parental leave policy — the
FAMILY Act — was introduced in September 2025 and would create a national
paid family and medical leave insurance program. The bill — co-sponsored
by U.S. Reps. Deluzio and Lee, among others — was referred to committee
upon its introduction, but has not advanced to a House floor vote. “Let’s
be honest, this is an issue that should be handled at a federal level,”
Lee said. “We shouldn’t have to be here, county by county, municipality by
municipality, or state by state, ensuring our families are taken care of.”
In lieu of that legislation, Deluzio applauded Innamorato and her
administration for pursuing a paid parental leave policy locally. “When
you go through something as important as starting a family, having a baby,
you shouldn’t be risking your job or your safety to care for yourself and
your baby,” he said. Deluzio said that he supported the recent changes to
the Allegheny County proposed policy made, in part, in response to input
from small business owners. “They were smart,” he said. “They reflected
feedback from the community and small business owners, especially.” State
Rep. La’Tasha Mayes, co-chair of the Black Maternal Health Caucus, said
most mothers, about 60%, return to work within three months of giving
birth — many within six to eight weeks. “You bring a baby into the world
and then you must return to work,” she said. “Your life has changed. Your
mind has changed. Your body has changed. Your thoughts should be about how
you heal and how you take care of your new baby, but the competing
thoughts are, ‘I’ve got to get back to work.’” Mayes said the policy would
ultimately help prevent maternal deaths, particularly for Black women who
have a significantly higher rate of maternal mortality than the national
average, and two and a half times higher than their white counterparts,
according to the county health department. Nationally, the CDC found that
the U.S. maternal mortality rate was 17.9 deaths per 100,000 live births
in 2024.

Sisters and Brothers –

The political future of our country rests upon one very simple principle:
the need for working people to stand together and fight back against
corporate greed, and create an economy that works for all of us, and not
just billionaires and large corporations.

So when we have progressive candidates with the guts to take on corporate
power in this country, we have to do what we can to support them if we are
going to have any chance at transforming this country and creating a
government that works for all of us.

One of those people is Congressman Chris Deluzio in Pennsylvania.

Chris understands that our current healthcare system is broken and wildly
expensive. He believes, as I do, that healthcare is a human right, not a
privilege, and that we must end the embarrassment of being the only major
country on earth that does not guarantee healthcare to every man, woman
and child. That is why he supports Medicare for All.

Chris understands that we have a corrupt campaign finance system which
allows the very rich and their super PACs to buy and sell politicians.
That is why he fights vigorously to end the disastrous Citizens United
Supreme Court decision — which allows Big Money to control our political
process.

Chris understands that too many workers in America are earning starvation
wages. That is why he fights to raise the minimum wage to a living wage,
to make it easier for workers to join unions, to build the millions of
units of low income and affordable housing this country desperately needs
and make sure that seniors can retire with dignity and security.

Sisters and brothers, Chris' campaign is about more than just one single
House seat. His work is about taking on the powerful special interests
that dominate our economic and political life.

And keeping him in Congress requires all of us to do our part to make it
happen. And that is why I am once again asking for your financial support.

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.AE9VfX&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1003&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Please contribute $27 or whatever you can afford to Chris Deluzio's
campaign for Congress in Pennsylvania. I intend to do my part, but it will
take all of us. Not just me. Us.

If you've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution
instantly:

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/362?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.b9L7t3&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1022&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Donate $5

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/35?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.nJj1HV&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1023&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Donate $25

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/29?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.E2bBFL&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1024&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Donate $50

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/30?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.zNz5CJ&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1025&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Donate $100

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/31?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.u3Q1jZ&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1026&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Donate $250

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/34?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.kjyCBj&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1027&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]Other Amount

When we act collectively, we have the ability not only to create a dynamic
progressive movement, but we will be able to transform our nation and
create a government that represents all of us, not just the people on top.

That’s the goal. Let’s do it.

In solidarity,

Bernie Sanders

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-jun26.AE9VfX&refcode=em261027-bernie&t=1028&akid=158%2E42639%2ETJoSIb ]CONTRIBUTE NOW

# Talarico v. Paxton
| |
---
|
---
Medical liberty is on the ballot this General Election, and the race for U.S. Senate deserves your attention. **Actual records speak louder than campaign rhetoric** , and the contrast of James Talarico and Ken Paxton could not be bigger: **_JAMES TALARICO: SIDES WITH BIG PHARMA_** Talarico has served in the Texas House since 2019. During that time, he has **repeatedly voted against medical liberty protections**. When lawmakers considered measures to prohibit vaccine-based discrimination, defend informed consent, and hold pharmaceutical companies accountable, **Talarico voted against those protections** (and several others!) every single time. He simply has not met a Pharma-backed bill he didn’t love. **_KEN PAXTON: DEFENDS MEDICAL LIBERTY_** When medical liberty is threatened, Ken Paxton has **time and time again used his office to challenge Big Pharma** , defend patient rights, and investigate conflicts of interest influencing childhood vaccine recommendations. And **HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. agrees!** At last week’s campaign stop in Fort Worth, Secretary Kennedy said he needs Paxton in D.C. to “challenge official orthodoxies and vested interests.” During his time as Attorney General, **Paxton****fearlessly stood in the trenches with TFVC** , and has even asked us for expert collaboration on investigations his office was conducting. You owe it to yourself and the future of medical freedom in Texas to know where these candidates stand before you vote. **Texas needs champions for medical liberty in positions of power at every level.** Before you head to the polls, study the record, and use the [**TFVC Voter Guide**](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/gw/c/v2.k1._YK2dWPKOgYMw1aDdTUl_ENiQDu2tDinaBZDZKtCRtb2Fvs7hnmQyNgIwQbTN3rhA_qS-OuVEshMglEM2UB2lMaUB7yc79IlC48O8x8UeWZyUYu0QFT7QrpPZo8VMqxFLqnlmkSV-xOoA3-JcnEL3OOnQ75lwUh8STRNpsNzOE_1lVrmIRAI_2m1krEq1ad4wMEwpZ6VcA32N-ONGZKwM4Sb2--uu6J-TYSfBa6895ZqOhF7NEgDvndr5MZZYAWkls_feOEGZ4_iyR1zfD6aaldotAfkcohVuqNN7L-BQ5A034Ks3Ho0KNaOBAbUrRa8ahYgPs5bIX3ikL5fijB41ng7NQAL58u_0hRxPRIhpLkqulQXgJLNAjuTR5fjYcOgCz3Efd8XdhsPeuFJdCCryPPpq5mle3JYDDKqyEUfL_HsiAVCYIKbp_8obNQ5zvcr9W8HF5NtUUl8ZLoHJl_wf1Dg6v8EkBmi0ay-MXDmcCUhNY3fqqRIx3s9c9QpI09UET6-gVZQbmlLT3JWRfzcgs0lu1I3baDVtGWy_bg) to make informed choices all the way down your ballot. **Every race and vote counts!**

clean_body: | | What the Real Record Reflects | | | | | | Talarico v. Paxton | | | Medical liberty is on the ballot this General Election, and the race for U.S. Senate deserves your attention. Actual records speak louder than campaign rhetoric , and the contrast of James Talarico and Ken Paxton could not be bigger: JAMES TALARICO: SIDES WITH BIG PHARMA Talarico has served in the Texas House since 2019. During that time, he has repeatedly voted against medical liberty protections. When lawmakers considered measures to prohibit vaccine-based discrimination, defend informed consent, and hold pharmaceutical companies accountable, Talarico voted against those protections (and several others!) every single time. He simply has not met a Pharma-backed bill he didn’t love. KEN PAXTON: DEFENDS MEDICAL LIBERTY When medical liberty is threatened, Ken Paxton has time and time again used his office to challenge Big Pharma , defend patient rights, and investigate conflicts of interest influencing childhood vaccine recommendations. And HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. agrees! At last week’s campaign stop in Fort Worth, Secretary Kennedy said he needs Paxton in D.C. to “challenge official orthodoxies and vested interests.” During his time as Attorney General, Paxtonfearlessly stood in the trenches with TFVC , and has even asked us for expert collaboration on investigations his office was conducting. You owe it to yourself and the future of medical freedom in Texas to know where these candidates stand before you vote. Texas needs champions for medical liberty in positions of power at every level. Before you head to the polls, study the record, and use the to make informed choices all the way down your ballot. I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor.

I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor.
| Peter,
**I know your inbox is probably overflowing right now with politicians begging for your hard-earned money using every scare tactic in the book.**
_I truly hate having to send messages like this, but I really appreciate your time!_
My last message didn't get the response I was hoping for, and now I'm starting to feel like we're falling behind. We can't keep fighting if we don't have the resources to keep the lights on and pay my amazing staff.
Let me take a second to re-introduce myself: _**My name is Jen Kiggans.**_
I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom.
---
[](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)
---
And that is exactly __**WHY**__ I ran for Congress in 2022.
I knew that I needed to step up and do my part to make sure that my four kids inherit a GREAT America!
Against all odds, we flipped Virginia's 2nd District **RED** in one of the tightest, must-win races in the entire country. But elections have serious consequences and these radical Left Democrats are not going to give up without a fight.
Now, National Democrats and Left-leaning Super PACs are raking in millions to attack me and take back the House this year. They want to turn our great commonwealth into California AND my far-Left opponent announced she raised over $1.6 MILLION in the last quarter alone.
_They will stop at absolutely nothing to win._
So today, I'm recruiting YOU to join my mission to save our country from the Democrats' grasp once and for all. That is why I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor. **[Will you chip in just a few dollars to support a former Navy pilot on this critical mission to SAVE OUR GOP HOUSE MAJORITY?](https://trk.email.repdailyred._H11kUZ-8eD84rFKqMw)**

As a Navy Vet, I've never turned away from a tough fight, and trust me, I won't start now. But to keep our House Majority intact and continue fighting for our country's future, I really need your support!
Thank you all so very, very much!
\- Jen Kiggans

I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America's success!

_**Patriot**_ , I’m going to keep this short, because it comes from the heart and those kind of things don’t need a lot of words. **We are one week out. In just a few days, the votes will be cas t.** I’ve been sitting here thinking about the miles we’ve put behind us to get to this point, and more than anything, thinking about you, **Patriot**. You know, back home in Jackson, we’ve got a saying: You find out who’s really in your corner when the road gets tough. _**Patriot**_ , you’ve been in my corner every single mile of this haul. Fellow Patriot,
I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell.
None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war.
Not one of us flinched.
Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way.
**And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me.**
_Here 's why._
America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win.
Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher."
**That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside.**
**_Our sovereignty?_** They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long.
**_Our culture?_** They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of.
**_And our kids?_** That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for.
A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it.
Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't.
_So it 's up to us._
**And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House.**
Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. **Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once.**
If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys.

You know what comes next. Endless witch hunts. Impeachment circuses. Every bill to secure the border and protect our elections will be dead on arrival. Two more years of the Left fighting to undo everything we've accomplished – and setting the stage to finish the job in 2028.
**This is the whole ballgame. Not one race._The entire House._**
I know that fight better than most. Last December, when our majority was on the line in Tennessee's special election, national Democrats threw everything they had at it. We beat them by nearly 9 points. Now they want revenge – on me and on every Republican standing between them and power.
**In just a matter of days, it all comes down to Election Day.** The Democrats and their media allies are watching every close race for a Republican who looks weak. Wherever they see weakness, they'll pile on. Wherever they see strength, they'll think twice.
_That 's why I'm coming to you directly._
**I 'm asking you to stand in the gap over these next few days – because right now, the House is the line, and we need patriots holding it.**

clean_body: | Fellow Patriot, I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell. None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war. Not one of us flinched. Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way. And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me. Here 's why. America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win. Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher." That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside. Our sovereignty? They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long. Our culture? They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of. And our kids? That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for. A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it. Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't. So it 's up to us. And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House. Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once. If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys. | You know what comes next. Endless witch hunts. Impeachment circuses. Every bill to secure the border and protect our elections will be dead on arrival. Two more years of the Left fighting to undo everything we've accomplished – and setting the stage to finish the job in 2028. This is the whole ballgame. Not one race.The entire House. I know that fight better than most. Last December, when our majority was on the line in Tennessee's special election, national Democrats threw everything they had at it. We beat them by nearly 9 points. Now they want revenge – on me and on every Republican standing between them and power. In just a matter of days, it all comes down to Election Day. The Democrats and their media allies are watching every close race for a Republican who looks weak. Wherever they see weakness, they'll pile on. Wherever they see strength, they'll think twice. That 's why I'm coming to you directly. I 'm asking you to stand in the gap over these next few days – because right now, the House is the line, and we need patriots holding it. The country's on the line and the threat is coming from within. That’s why I'm asking you to answer the call with me – for our sovereignty, for our way of life and for the kids who deserve to inherit the same America we did. Please don 't wait. The clock is running. For God and country, Matt Van Epps P.S. America has never been beaten from the outside – only we can destroy her. subject: Please don't take my appreciation for granted

Because this isn't easy. It's an absolute dogfight, and you have to love the fight, really love it, to keep pushing when the odds are stacked against you.

| Please don't take my appreciation for granted, Friend.The love I have for you, for Minnesota, and for this country. How many people can say they've put everything on the line and have been within striking distance of making history by flipping Minnesota - a Democrat stronghold - to the Republican column?Not many. Because this isn't easy. It's an absolute dogfight, and you have to love the fight, really love it, to keep pushing when the odds are stacked against you.That's exactly what I've done. And I'm not backing down now.I've dedicated everything I have to flipping the US Senate seat in Minnesota, and there is no question in my mind that this is the right choice when I've seen first-hand what Peggy Flanagan and Tim Walz have done. All the rampant fraud that took place here occurred under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as under Tim Walz. # Conforti Grassroots Newsletter
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

**Welcome to the final week of our campaign!**.With the 2026 Midterm Election just one week away, this interactive grassroots newsletter is your central hub for the final push to bring true representation back to the hardworking constituents of Illinois' 6th Congressional District..Our campaign has always been built on a "district-first" mentality, prioritizing your needs through sensible solutions and open dialogue. Now, we need your help to cross the finish line. As we continue to provide you with regular updates on policy, campaign events, and current community events happening right here in our district, your active participation is more critical than ever..Please click the button below to make a donation today—your grassroots contributions will help us flip the 6th District in this final push!
---

District-First Events.

### Educate. Inform. Invite.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
# Kitchen Table Tuesday
---
| | **Educating and connecting** with voters on important issues.
---
| | |
---
| | In our everyday lives, we need a photo ID to buy cough syrup and to get on an airplane—**we should also need a photo ID to vote.** This is why one of my top priorities in Congress is strengthening election integrity. To protect the ballot box, my goal is to re-implement the need for three forms of ID to register to vote, alongside a strict requirement for a photo ID at the polling booth. .By implementing these basic, common-sense measures, the impact will be clear and immediate: it **ensures that only eligible voters are participating in the democratic process.** We must secure our elections, so they remain fair and truly representative of our hardworking citizens. I will confidently fight for these essential reforms in Washington to restore faith in our system and guarantee that every legal vote is protected.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| | **Modernizing Women’s Healthcare: Putting Patients First and Protecting Taxpayer Dollars**.Recently, NBC News reported that the President and First Lady signed an executive order establishing a new Women’s Health Division at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) alongside a White House Women’s Health Task Force led by the Secretary of Health and Human Services and the Chief of Staff. **Aiming to close research gaps and modernize care, the initiative also highlights the need to improve the access and affordability of healthcare for women across the nation.** Furthermore, the administration has moved to cut wasteful NIH grants on diversity-related topics, align federal Title X family planning funds with pro-family priorities, and conduct a vital safety review of the abortion pill, mifepristone..These federal efforts address critical issues affecting families right here in Illinois' 6th Congressional District. Niki Conforti supports the actions the HHS Secretary is taking to improve public health policy, believing that federal health entities must focus strictly on objective science and transparency rather than publicly funded advocacy. **For far too long, Democrat-championed policies like Obamacare have been a disaster for Illinois, shrinking consumer choices to just two options in many counties and causing healthcare costs to skyrocket over the last decade.** Instead of fighting to make healthcare affordable for his constituents, incumbent Democrat Sean Casten has focused on partisan messaging and pushing a radical abortion agenda—including despicable support for taxpayer-funded and late-term abortions that directly opposes the values of his constituents. .**Having spent 12 years in healthcare leadership roles, Niki Conforti brings invaluable industry experience to the table and maintains a strict "district-first" mentality.** When elected to Congress, Niki will build on these federal reforms and fight for the hardworking families of the 6th District. Niki will look at policies, such as: .
* **Lowering Healthcare Costs Through Transparency:** Pushing for real reform that enforces strict transparency in medical billing, eliminating surprise bills and fostering free-market competition among healthcare systems to naturally drive down prices for patients.
* **Expanding Consumer Choice and Flexibility:** Consumers deserve more options in the marketplace. Niki supports allowing families to purchase and transport health insurance policies across state lines and expanding Health Savings Accounts (HSAs).
* **Protecting Life and Taxpayer Dollars:** Proudly Pro-Life with exceptions for rape, incest, and the life of the mother, Niki will fiercely oppose the Democrats' radical abortion agenda.
* **Eliminating Bureaucratic Waste and DEI Mandates:** Downsizing bloated federal bureaucracies, dismantling divisive DEI practices in the federal government, and conducting rigorous audits to root out the waste and fraud draining our national treasury.
* **Evaluating AI with a District-First Approach:** As new technologies like artificial intelligence are utilized to speed up medical discoveries, Niki believes AI should be regulated by the federal government using a "district-first" approach—evaluating policies by whether they truly protect and benefit local workers, families, and patients.

. It is time to **replace a broken, unaffordable system with sensible solutions** that empower women and families, protect the unborn, and deliver true healthcare affordability. .
Stay informed on this issue—[**read the full breakdown here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/zPzyPa1WqVT?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)

| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
# District-First
# Events
---
| | **Inviting voters** to community events and how they can get involved!**
**You are cordially invited to our**Election Night Watch Party!**
---
| |
---
| | **Join the Conforti Campaign at Our Official Election Night Watch Party!**.We warmly invite you to join Niki Conforti, our campaign team, and fellow supporters on Election Night as the results come in for Illinois' 6th Congressional District! **Come out to show your support for our "District-First" vision** and celebrate the hard work and grassroots momentum that have driven our campaign from day one. Together, we have stood united in the fight to defeat incumbent Sean Casten and bring sensible solutions, economic affordability, and community safety back to our neighborhoods.
.
* **Date:** Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (Election Night!)
* **Time:** Doors open at 6:30 PM (CST)
* **Location:** Salerno's Pizzeria & Sports Bar in Hodgkins, IL (9301 W. 63rd St., Hodgkins, IL 60525)
.

Bring your family, friends, and neighbors to gather with us as we watch the returns and look ahead to bringing true accountability and a "district-first" mentality to Washington.We would love to have you join our ranks for this exciting evening!
.
To RSVP or get more details, please contact our team at [**info@conforti4congress.com.**](mailto:info@conforti4congress.com?subject=Election%20Night%20Watch%20Party&body=)
.
.
.
**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (DuPage County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot:**August 5th**
* Early voting and vote-by-mail voting begins: **September 24th**
* Last day to request a vote-by-mail ballot: **October 29th**
* Last day for early voting: **November 2nd**
* General Election Day:**November 3rd**
.

**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (Cook County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot: **August 5th**
* First day to vote early in Chicago (Downtown Only): **September 24th** Last day for online voter registration: **October 18th**
* Early voting opens in all 50 city wards and suburban Cook County: **October 19th**
* Deadline for vote-by-mail applications: **October 29th**
* General Election Day: **November 3rd**
.

**Get out the vote:** whether you plan to vote by mail, early voting in person, or voting in person on election day, it’s important we get out the vote to defeat incumbent Sean Casten.

# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261027-6890-footer&t=1&akid=6890%2E420207%2EEtLkPB)
7 days, Peter.

I was guided by a simple principle: **When you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work.** And yet, I’ve seen Ohioans working harder than ever and still being left behind while Washington politicians give handout after handout to billionaires and corporate special interests. **[The time for self-serving agendas needs to end, but we can’t make it happen unless we all work together in this final stretch. Will you split $5 or more between my campaign and Able Dems today to help me cross the finish line, win in Ohio, and take back the Senate?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvbp_fjzhxiAn8NfrkNOSULpCCZkdFZ4RAddlB9BuuvgM-CBgBOUDYiuDRsJAqlSltamnLnhOrEH_UWICbyLBjvN09WnIJvaOo62-o6NvBAX8_E4av4iesZoPdQzWRrDrbKBc098FhOFFrIWPuPuH47XU0egudjMN06t63yZxPPD4ggRpJd9dENoaREdhb5pQq2Z-SUgddWQBZvAh3-VHrxvpzjHFKBEAShhHh9W8Kz7_FvWhRdYNT5IoTi5qv56wAXntiHuY0PZ3dqzxsZma2A5tep_XIlg4VydHJR4c_VCw/4v8/yT5G-2HfTh2hFcVGoVJZ5A/h1/h001.JC-O7FKvtH0sv9edRx4Ts8Fg-06CTY-tPFgVschKDYg)** [DONATE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvbp_fjzhxiAn8NfrkNOSULPXkwPHT7EGD_qydlipQzuh2ufrRXF-3DJgD7-9_UhsANMK5l50C-r6XC1FNsRtL9I63qbeSS2_R6tOtiIdWMHTUbi8EaZqi6w7EdrW3RyPMruLS0tbFYrzwlOAF0JSkueRX3z8S1zDQG32IfPMIY_uFCII7geLhsAO81Hl01Dq-gt1y8WkB19EXKKVzR5r9SsYaW_w4eX0B90TBul4HxO6VDB56hzmTqTqLCIcN_LmaqUNCBxcBbyMlm_OUwF14bQ-hfBC8JNGsVnMZ1NjcZ_w/4v8/yT5G-2HfTh2hFcVGoVJZ5A/h2/h001.xW-fLuK4Cgea-x33awz7ITD8i-ac_vfk7dZmpc0VmAU) I didn’t plan to run for office again. clean_body: Together, we can build an economy where hard work pays off and where everyone has a shot at a decent life. | | | Friend, with Election Day just days away, I’ve been reflecting on why I got in this race. I was guided by a simple principle: When you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. And yet, I’ve seen Ohioans working harder than ever and still being left behind while Washington politicians give handout after handout to billionaires and corporate special interests. I didn’t plan to run for office again. But I couldn’t sit on the sidelines while Jon Husted and politicians like him in Washington kept failing the people of Ohio. This campaign has never been about left versus right. It’s about who you fight for – and who you’re willing to stand up to. When we fought to save the pensions of tens of thousands of Ohio retirees, we stood up to Wall Street and won. When we fought to cap insulin prices and bring down the cost of prescription drugs, we stood up to Big Pharma and won. I knew a campaign founded on the idea of unrigging the system for working folks had the legs to win. This movement we’ve created has been truly incredible – and it’s all thanks to supporters like you. But I’m in the fight of my life to flip this seat, and this final stretch is incredibly tough. The GOP and its right-wing billionaire donors are spending millions to mislead voters and attack me, and the only way I can fight back and win is with your grassroots support. With Election Day exactly one week away, I wanted to share an update on my race against Andy Barr and ask for your support.
Trump and his allies are pouring _millions_ into Kentucky to protect their grip on power. Attack ads are flooding the airwaves, and they're doing everything they can to drown out our Kentucky-first message.
But we're not backing down.
My opponent and I are tied in the polls. **This is the most competitive race Kentucky has seen in a generation, and we cannot afford to take a single vote for granted.

** We need to reach as many Kentucky voters as possible before they head to the polls in just _one week._ That means making sure they hear directly from me, not just the attacks funded by Trump and his deep-pocketed allies.
Unlike Andy, I'm not relying on Trump and wealthy special interests to fund this campaign. I'm relying on people like you who believe Kentucky deserves better.
**With just 7 days left, will you make a contribution today to help us reach voters and bring this race across the finish line?**
[ Make a donation to my Senate Campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/a92a4a5e-e4ff-4bb8-a81b-8edcb9ab4bd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Make a recurring donation](https://substack.com/redirect/878f5f90-51d2-40ca-b47c-555c801d41e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you.
Charles Booker

subject: What's your plan for Tuesday?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire, Dan Gray, Treasurer, 45 Lafayette Rd
body:
We have one week to get voters to the polls on Election Day...

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/FHCiANHuSob?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)
| | | | | | Peter,

**We have seven days...**

That’s all that stands between now and the election that will decide who will fight for our New Hampshire values in Concord.

I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again...**We cannot afford to sit this one out.**

If we do not show up next Tuesday, November 3, our legislature will be filled with radical extremists who will sell out our values, our freedom, and our way of life every chance they get.

Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire has done our homework. We spoke with the candidates. We learned where they stand. **That is why we have officially endorsed 155 liberty champions who have signed The Pledge** and made a public promise to fight for you.
[**See our full list of endorsed candidates by clicking here!**](https://us.list-manage.com/ckkSF33Y9Gv?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)

| | **We have one week to get voters to the polls on Election Day.**

Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire has teams on the ground knocking doors and speaking with voters about these important races, but we need all hands on deck.

**If you want to help Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire knock more doors before polls close on Tuesday, you can go to:** [www.CitizensAllianceNH.org/donate](https://us.list-manage.com/7xwkL4IjS8s?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70) **and sponsor a doorknocker for $175!**

If you’ve already donated, start a group chat with your friends, family members, neighbors, and coworkers and encourage them to make a plan to vote next week.

**If we want a legislature that represents our Live Free or Die state, we have to show up next week.

**Mark your calendar. Make your plan. Talk to the people around you.

Then get to the polls next Tuesday, November 3, and vote for the [Pledge Signers](https://us.list-manage.com/XqjWQLH8t0o?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70) who will stand for liberty.

We look forward to seeing you at the polls.

LET’S WIN!

Meet Mark Harris:
**Mark Harris is a father, grandfather, pastor, and now a sitting member of Congress who has spent his life in service to his faith, his family, and the people of North Carolina.

Born and raised in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, and a graduate of R.J. Reynolds High School, Mark earned a Bachelor of Science in Political Science from Appalachian State University. Not long before marrying his college sweetheart, Beth, he felt a calling to ministry, going on to earn his Master of Divinity and Doctor of Ministry in Christian Leadership from Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary.

Mark spent decades in pastoral ministry across North Carolina and Georgia, leading congregations at Center Grove Baptist in Clemmons and Curtis Baptist in Augusta before becoming Senior Pastor of First Baptist Charlotte, where he served for more than a decade and guided the church through difficult economic times without taking on debt.

Mark now represents the people of North Carolina's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, where he serves on the Agriculture, Education and Workforce, and Judiciary Committees, fighting every day for pro-family values, lower taxes, and a government that actually listens to the people it serves.

Mark and Beth have three adult children and eleven grandchildren, and call North Carolina home.

Now, Mark is running for reelection because North Carolina deserves a fighter in Washington who will never stop standing up for faith, family, and freedom. **

[](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013M2VgDcKV-bAW3B6UWlof4JNODssNWGStAZ0T0jXr_5PBPmYm3lzv3C_lQIAjapvtuqhlz5T1E_CbqieT_oUxH5riYZ29TzucMa9L3eSwVmkvwR3xxwDUMcroqaMDa4BquWo26rXjNU1wVbik_J-T1P1zB8llN6ZjGhOv4cnuN_VXSWva79bLmEBoaUjpJJjZnj-wB85zyNCuuQq5mrbPRRRx-m9WfDnw0ZMSJvgink=&c=-Y4PkLMdfJUuKJF-HdcEBedMomTTS1G9dK4z8gNFj4DLLdA8F3h_qA==&ch=fXEtH1Nj_q2J1JqlmvT6imUtZJMPJaAFSsWH7_QSBGKB_AROG6iVsQ==) Friend, I was 29 years old when Susan Collins first became my senator.

That’s me in the middle of that photo, when my fellow loggers and I were up at the border fighting for fair wages.

Now I’m 58 years old, _and Susan is still my senator. _

After 30 years in Washington, she’s become a corporate puppet who does the bidding of her billionaire donors and Donald Trump – she’s voted with him 96% of the time.

Mainers are sick and tired of her broken promises and her fake concern. But being in the Senate for half of my entire life means every single voter is gonna know who she is when they see her name on the ballot this November.

On the other hand, I’m a logger from Allagash who started this campaign just over a month ago.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Just one week left to make our case
body:
With just seven days left in the race, I ask that you do not hesitate.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1767&source=&t=1&akid=5007%2E124072%2EhGjFoS) | | | |
---
Peter,
This U.S. Senate race will be over in seven days, and many North Carolinians are casting their ballots as you read this.
[**_With time running out to make our case to undecided voters, your $5 *today* is worth more than $5 a few days from now. We have to keep our final ads running, but we can’t do that without your grassroots support toward our final end-of-month deadline on Saturday. Will you please chip in right away?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1767&amount=5&t=8&akid=5007%2E124072%2EhGjFoS)**
While I don’t usually speak in superlatives, the urgency of this moment cannot be overstated:
My opponent, Michael Whatley, admits that he’s only running **because President Trump asked him to.** If he wins, his top priority will be to do and say whatever Trump _tells him_ to – regardless of whether it’s good for the people of our state. It’d also guarantee that the GOP keeps Senate control until 2029 – at least.
That means another two years of this Administration’s chaotic policies and unchecked corruption making stuff cost _even more_ for hardworking folks in need of relief.
Preventing that requires Democrats to take back the reins of power on Capitol Hill for the people. **The only way it happens is by flipping this seat blue for the first time since 2008.**
So for our final end-of-month deadline of the race, I set a $5 million goal – because that’s the kind of money it takes to keep our message in front of voters from now until Election Day.
Unlike Michael Whatley, I can’t count on MAGA megadonors to fund my campaign. I rely on folks like you, Peter, chipping in $5 to get us across the finish line. [**_If you’re able to give that much or more right now, I ask that you do not hesitate. Every dollar will go to work keeping our ads live and reaching the voters we need to win._](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1767&amount=5&t=9&akid=5007%2E124072%2EhGjFoS)**

Peggy Flanagan is in a slight lead for the seat that would make her the first Native American woman EVER in the U.S. Senate. And Donald Trump himself just said last night that if she wins, he will call it fraudulent. Deb Haaland is defending her lead to become the first Native American woman ever elected governor — in a state that barred her people from voting until 1948. Sharice Davids and Claire Valdez are fighting for the House seats a Democratic majority runs through. All five are tied or ahead. All five races get decided by what happens in the next seven days. This is the sprint to run the final ads, knock the final doors, and reach every last voter. ~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | ~~ With gratitude, Indigenous Women Lead PAC | Paid for by Indigenous Women Lead PAC Indigenous Women Lead PACPO Box 15845Washington, DC 20003United States

subject: One week. I'm not backing down.

body:

Hey Derek, One week. That's all that's left until Election Day. And here's something I want you to know: I'm not changing who I am just because an election is around the corner. I didn't come to Washington to tell people what they want to hear. I came to stand with Pennsylvania, speak my mind, and do what I believe is right. [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53794?t=2&akid=11058%2E434096%2E1fmMmp) | [CHIP IN $25](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53794?t=3&akid=11058%2E434096%2E1fmMmp)

That means rejecting socialism, the DSA, and political extremism. It means working across the aisle when it makes sense. And it means standing my ground, even when it's unpopular.
**I'm not interested in political games. I'm interested in getting things done.**
With just seven days until Election Day, I'm asking you to help me keep that message front and center.
[**Can you chip in $25 today to support my fight for common sense and putting hardworking Pennsylvanians first**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53794?t=4&akid=11058%2E434096%2E1fmMmp)
I'm never going to agree with everyone. And I don't expect everyone to agree with me.
But you deserve to know where I stand. No guessing. No pretending. No nonsense.
That's how I've always approached this job, and that's not going to change.
One week to go. Let's finish strong.
Thanks for all you do, Derek.
John

body:
Second place is the first loser.
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261027-brown.guIpX9&amount=5&refcode=em20261027-5779&t=1&akid=5779%2E35263%2E9LsMLV)
Peter, let me be clear: **There is no second place in this race.**
There’s no silver medal, no participation prize – and no “try again next year.” Our race in Ohio will decide Senate control, and I can’t stress enough how high the stakes are.
Second place means rising costs for hardworking families.
Second place means cuts to healthcare coverage so that the wealthiest Americans get more tax breaks.
**Second place means giving Jon Husted two more years of being Trump’s puppet – and it means giving up our best shot at flipping the Senate.**
That’s why I need your help, Peter. Right now, we’re tied in the polls, and Republican megadonors are spending a quarter of a BILLION dollars to help Husted surge ahead.
The only way I can fight back is with your immediate help. I’m relying on grassroots support from folks like you to ensure the values and priorities of Ohio working families come in first place on November 3.
**[Will you split $5 right now between my campaign and Tammy Baldwin to win in Ohio and flip the Senate? On Friday night, I was joined by Governor Josh Stein and Justice Anita Earls for an amazing Get Out The Vote concert. We heard from North Carolina musical artists Davie Circle, Karly Hartzman, Tift Merritt, Hiss Golden Messenger and Watchhouse x Viv & Riley!
Get Out The Vote Concert!
More than a thousand people spent their Friday night supporting our campaign, hearing about the stakes of this election and listening to some great artists. With just 7 days until Election Day, now is the time for folks across the state to grab a friend and head to the polls to cast their ballots.
Working families need a change and I'm ready to bring some North Carolina common sense to Washington DC to make stuff cost less. If you are ready to join me and fight for the people of North Carolina, please [chip in a few dollars](https://substack.com/redirect/5015329f-a650-45bd-ade5-a01566f606cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or [volunteer to knock doors.](https://substack.com/redirect/b65ad439-73de-45e7-83d8-6b783abd3ef9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Let's finish this strong.

Peter,
It’s Congressman Troy Downing.
I'll be honest with you – there have been moments during this campaign when I genuinely wondered whether enough people out there still cared the way I hoped they would.
But then something happens that restores that faith.
A stranger stops me at an event to say they're praying for this campaign. A volunteer shows up at 7 a.m. to knock doors before their own workday even starts.
[A donor who's never given a dollar to a political campaign in their life decides this is the year they finally do.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._ZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYxMDI3XzE0LUtGLjExMDExN190MjA3Mzg5MC0yODk5JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MTAyN18xNC1LRi4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNzM4OTAtMjg5OSJ9/nLnrG6Th7qFFHrGCYPVFCQ)

I'm writing today because I'm hoping you're one of those people – especially with our House Majority on the line.
If you've been waiting for the right moment to get more involved, then this is it. [Please consider chipping in $10, $15, or quite literally any amount today – I promise every cent helps.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._6KT-etIfA)

body:
Chip in before Election Day

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=3067%2E4032634%2E2mPDjL)
---
Just over a week ago, I stood with my friend Troy Jackson in Portland, looking out at about a thousand Mainers. You could feel it in that crowd. People are tired of watching billionaires and Trump’s corruption. They’re ready to take their country back, and they want a government that works for them. Sound familiar? It’s not just happening in Maine. I’ve heard the same thing in every state I’ve visited this year: in town halls, at kitchen tables, and from crowds just like the one in Portland. Americans everywhere are ready for change. That’s why what happens in Maine matters so much. The road to a Senate majority depends on it. And with a majority, we can hold Trump’s administration accountable, block his extreme judges, and pass policies that lower costs for working families. Susan Collins has spent 30 years in Washington. Troy Jackson has spent his life in northern Maine, working as a logger and fighting for working families as a union man. He knows what it’s like to work hard and still struggle to get ahead, and he’s spent his career taking on powerful interests — and winning. **The choice couldn’t be clearer.** [**We have one week left to help Troy get across the finish line. Every contribution can help his campaign reach voters and make the case for change before they cast their ballots. Please split a donation between Troy Jackson’s campaign and our movement today.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3883?t=8&akid=3067%2E4032634%2E2mPDjL)

body:
[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20261027-61944&t=1001&akid=61944%2E1407376%2EWqO1uK ]Demand Justice PAC[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20261027-61944&t=1002&akid=61944%2E1407376%2EWqO1uK ]Demand Justice PAC

BREAKING: Demand Justice
just released a new report exposing Trump’s election-denying judges, and
the findings are alarming.

Trump-appointed, election-denying federal judges preside over 53 of the 60
most competitive races this November.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20261027.ei3_vG&refcode=em20261027-61944&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=61944%2E1407376%2EWqO1uK ]Map showing 53 of the 60 battleground House and Senate races that fall
under a federal judge who refused to say Trump lost in 2020.

Every one of these judges refused, under oath, to admit Trump lost in
2020. They hedged, deflected, and pointed to “certification,” all to avoid
saying Joe Biden won.

→ 29 battleground races have one of these judges on the district court.
→ 38 races could face one of these judges on appeal.
→ 56 of Trump’s election-denying judges are now confirmed, with lifetime
appointments.

If Trump challenges a race that decides control of Congress, the case
could land before one of his judges who’ve shown they’ll lie about an
election to appease him.

And it’s already started. Last week, Trump’s DOJ sued to block
certification of Alaska’s Senate race if Republican Senator Dan Sullivan
loses.

This is Trump’s election interference plan. After years of attacking our
elections, he’s building the machinery to overturn any result he doesn’t
like.

Sow doubt. File suit. Get a friendly judge. Lock in the outcome that
serves him and his cronies.

And he’s stacked the very courts that threw out his 2020 election
lawsuits, filling them with political puppets placed right where he’ll
need them to back his abuses of power.

We can’t count on the courts to protect us this time. We have to fight
back from the outside, before November’s results land in their hands. That
means dragging these judges’ records into the light, so every reporter,
election official, and voter knows who could rule on their election.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20261027.ei3_vG&refcode=em20261027-61944&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=61944%2E1407376%2EWqO1uK ]Will you chip in $5 right now to help Demand Justice PAC
get this report in front of as many people as possible and put these
judges under a spotlight they can’t escape?

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20261027.ei3_vG&amount=5&refcode=em20261027-61944&t=1023&akid=61944%2E1407376%2EWqO1uK ]Donate $5 ››

Thank you,

Demand Justice PAC

P.S. You can read more about these judges in our [ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55784?t=1024&akid=61944%2E1407376%2EWqO1uK ]report.

name: Caitlin Cattelino
subject: Reminder: Thursday webinar on the permitting bill and endangered species!
body:
Join Defenders to learn more about a dangerous Senate bill threatening endangered wildlife and how you can help defeat it!

Join Defenders to learn more about a dangerous Senate bill threatening endangered wildlife and how you can help defeat it!
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6210966/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6210967/38SyG9Xl)

Dear Defender,

Congress will be back in Washington, D.C. after the November 3rd election and we need our Senators to hear your opposition to the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (S. 5653). If passed, this permitting reform bill would make vast and dangerous changes to the Endangered Species Act, our country’s strongest tool for preventing extinction.

There is still time to reserve your seat for our webinar on Thursday, October 29!

Defenders experts will be sharing our concerns about the damaging ESA provisions in S. 5653 and we’ll walk through ways you can take action to urge your Senator to oppose this bill!

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6210968/38SyG9Xl)

RSVP to receive your zoom link! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6210969/38SyG9Xl)

WHAT: Wildlife Defenders Webinar –

Oppose the Senate permitting bill

WHEN: Thursday, October 29

TIME: 1:00pm ET / 12:00pm CT /

11:00am MT / 10:00am PT

WHERE: Live via Zoom

RSVP here to receive your zoom link! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6210970/38SyG9Xl)

We agree that America needs affordable energy, a modern electric grid, more housing and infrastructure capable of meeting the demands of a growing economy. However, we do not need to, nor should we, sacrifice our country’s wildlife and natural heritage to do so. There is clear evidence that the ESA is not the obstacle to development that opponents claim it is. And S. 5653 would weaken fundamental wildlife protections without addressing the problems that actually slow development.

We want to connect with wildlife advocates who support protecting our cherished wildlife, not gutting vital conservation laws, like the ESA, in the name of infrastructure development.

Now is the time to raise our voices and tell our Senators to vote NO on S. 5653. RSVP to save your spot at our webinar! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6210971/38SyG9Xl)

I hope to see you on Thursday!

Caitlin Cattelino

Director of National Outreach

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

**TUESDAY, OCTOBER 27, 2026**
**Benjamin Franklin | Autobiography**
"But mark how luxury will enter families, and make a progress, in spite of principle."
Benjamin Franklin wrote this after discovering that his wife, Deborah, had replaced his ordinary breakfast bowl and spoon with china and silver. As Franklin recounted it, she thought he deserved what his neighbors had.
Franklin saw a departure from frugality. Deborah saw something her husband deserved.
It was only a bowl and a spoon. Yet beneath this small domestic disagreement lay a question that reaches into almost every household: What happens when the principles we live by meet the people we love?
Perhaps the test of a principle is not only how firmly we hold it, but how we understand it when someone we love looks at it from a different angle.
**Pause.
Breath.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2e8804da-a09a-4e78-b38d-6ffa1f96d4a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**A SWEET GROUND INVITATION**
In Sweet Ground, we reflect on the people who shape us, the choices we make, what we must sometimes unlearn, and what we carry forward.
Now, I would like to hear from you.
Is there a moment from your own life that has stayed with you? Something a parent or grandparent taught you, a conversation you never forgot, a lesson you understood only years later, or an ordinary moment that turned out not to be so ordinary?
**[Share your Sweet Ground moment in the comments.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/915d3800-69cb-4160-a13b-fea0071e01b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **A few words are enough. A memory, a story, even a photograph with a few words about what it means to you.
There is no right answer and no perfect story. Just something from your life that you carry with you.
I would love to hear it.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
Hey everybody,
To quote the late Robert Hunter of The Grateful Dead, "What a long strange trip it's been."
We started driving through these eleven counties in the second half of June 2025. Fifteen months and 35,000 miles later, we're down to the end, and in the last few weeks have felt like we have been closing the circle.
The first county Democratic party we visited was with the Randolph County Blues. We visited them for the third time two weeks ago. This time, instead of me asking a lot of questions to learn what the county needed or giving a speech about how we were going to help the county, we got to sit and chat with people who have become friends.
Our first big public event was in October 2025 at Fall on Main in Roanoke. We went back this weekend, and the vibe had shifted. Last year, the election was more than a year away, and overseas farm markets collapsed because of tariffs, so people had more pressing concerns. This year, only one person refused to talk to me, and he was very polite. Hundreds of people stopped to talk about the election and to hear what we're saying about the issues. Lots of people said they had seen me online, and they were voting for me, and more than a few stopped by to say they had already voted absentee for me.
Then on Thursday, we're heading back to Heflin for a Cleburne County Democratic Party meeting. I went to the Cleburne County party in the summer of 2025. We've been there a few times in the last 15 months, and it will be our last county meeting before the election.
The one stop I wanted to make but couldn't was in Tallapoosa County. Tallapoosa has been so supportive of this campaign over the last year, and I really wanted to make their candidates' forum, but I felt I needed to close the circle and go back to Fall on Main. I had nothing to worry about. Barb represented the campaign, and everyone said she knocked it out of the park.
I'll be honest: I'm exhausted, but looking back over the last 15 months, I'm incredibly proud of what we've accomplished. Next week, after the votes are counted, I'll write something to tell you all what this means to me. But right now, it is unbelievable that I get to say...
We are 7 days away from the general election.
Be well. We'll talk soon,

Lee
