A fighter loyal to Yemen's Saud-backed internationally-recognized government fires a turret from the back of a pickup truck at a position along the frontlines against Ansarallah around Mount al-Midan in Yemen's western Taiz province on October 26, 2026. Photo by Ahmad AL-BASHA / AFP via Getty Images.
The United Arab Emirates, a key American and Israeli ally in the Gulf, has been quietly assisting Ansarallah in its conflict against Saudi-backed forces inside Yemen, four sources with knowledge of the situation told Drop Site News.
Specifically, various UAE-aligned Yemeni forces have been providing targeting assistance to Ansarallah in their battle against Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen while Abu Dhabi has looked the other way, the sources said.
According to two sources with knowledge of the covert arrangement, the UAE's assistance has also included direct sharing of intelligence by the UAE itself to Ansarallah for the purpose of targeting Saudi-backed forces.
A Yemeni source familiar with the Ansarallah backchannel confirmed that "the UAE has passed a significant amount of intelligence to the Sana'a-based government; the line of communication between the two sides remains open." The Yemeni source told Drop Site that Ansarallah "established their own channels of communication internally with military commanders" who remain loyal to the UAE. The sources required anonymity as they are not authorized to speak publicly about the arrangement.
That the UAE is directly aiding one of its chief regional opponents is extraordinary. The UAE and Ansarallah are fierce ideological enemies with geopolitical goals that are in direct opposition to one another. The UAE is a close ally of Israel and the United States while Ansarallah is a close ally of Iran. However, when it comes to Yemen, their interests have come to overlap to some extent, producing a classic enemy-of-my enemy situation. The UAE was sidelined in Yemen earlier this year by Saudi Arabia, and stands to regain a strategic foothold in Yemen in the current conflict.
The assistance to Ansarallah from the UAE, some of the sources said, does not include help with intelligence and targeting inside Saudi Arabia, but is limited to help with targeting and intelligence inside Yemen. Ansarallah's attacks on Saudi Arabia included strikes on Saudi's main airport, one of which killed 12 people and wounded more than 300 others--and led to the cancellation of the Future Investment Initiative conference, otherwise known as the "Davos in the Desert."
Recently, according to one source, a senior American official warned the Emirates that the U.S. had learned of the covert assistance being provided and urged that it be ended. Sources indicated the intelligence assistance was ongoing. UAE Ambassador to the U.S. Yousef Al Otaiba did not respond to requests for comment.
Mohammed al-Bukhaiti, a senior Ansarallah official, denied that the UAE was assisting Ansarallah but insisted the Emirates were committed to neutrality. "The UAE has not provided any form of support to Yemen--neither against Saudi Arabia nor against its proxies within Yemen," he told Drop Site. "According to our information, the UAE remains committed to neutrality and has refused to become re-involved in the aggression against Yemen alongside Saudi Arabia, despite persistent efforts by [Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed] bin Salman to persuade it to join."
Last month, the Iran-backed Ansarallah, also known as the Houthis, launched a blitz to the Red Sea coast that stunned the region, routed Saudi-backed forces, and left Ansarallah in control of the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, one of the world's busiest shipping lanes and an important alternative to the blockaded Strait of Hormuz. Saudi efforts to regain territory have largely been repelled. Since then, Saudi Arabia has increasingly bombed Sana'a and other Ansarallah-controlled areas, while Ansarallah have conducted multiple strikes on Saudi Arabia.
Beginning in 2015, the Emirates were allied with Saudi Arabia as part of a coalition backing the Yemeni government, after Ansarallah swept south from its stronghold in the northern highlands and took over Sana'a in 2014. The Yemeni government is commonly referred to as the internationally recognized government, or IRG, and it remains largely based in Riyadh. But, early in the conflict, the UAE's aims and ambitions were at odds with the Saudis, causing division in the anti-Ansarallah side. In December of last year, that friction resulted in clashes between UAE-backed forces and Saudi-backed military units in the south and the UAE was effectively [expelled](https://substack.com/redirect/ec25eab2-0b18-42f6-b6a9-75d6ee54247c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Yemen by force.
Earlier this month, [The Guardian reported](https://substack.com/redirect/1619a0b8-1045-4b17-aae2-d3056accf6c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the UAE was re-entering the Yemeni conflict on the side of Saudi Arabia by agreeing to resume some payments to some of the forces it had backed.
That backing would most likely come through supporting the Giants "Al Amaliqah" Brigades, a predominantly Salafi militia ideologically opposed to the Houthis with an estimated 20,000 to 30,000 largely southern fighters. The Southern Giants are[ currently battling](https://substack.com/redirect/d719af11-069d-43c1-be20-9867f6edf905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for control of the Kahboub mountain range overlooking the Bab al-Mandab.
This potential support has not been reflected on the battlefield, the Yemeni source said. Many commanders within the Giants Brigades have deceived the Saudi-backed forces, the source said, repeatedly abandoning their positions without any engagement or confrontation.
The source also told Drop Site that military unit commanders affiliated with the UAE-backed Southern Transitional Council (STC) have refrained from fighting the Houthis, effectively stalling battlefronts--particularly in the southern governorates of Al-Dhale, and Lahj--bordering Taiz governorate, and frequently withdraw from their positions.
A UAE-based senior official categorically stated to Drop Site that "the STC has no channels of communication with the Houthis" and denied that STC were refusing to fight Ansarallah in the south.**** "The STC has publicly and consistently maintained that the Southern Armed Forces will not participate in military operations in the North," Amr al-Beidh, special representative of the president of the STC, told Drop Site. "This should not be confused with an unwillingness to confront the Houthis. Quite the opposite. Any Houthi advance towards the South will be met with resistance."
"It is important to distinguish between our policy of not engaging in military operations in the north and our firm commitment to defending the South against the Houthis," he added.
The White House and a spokesperson for the Saudi-led coalition did not respond to requests for comment.

More than 250,000 people have been displaced by the escalating violence since August 1, [according to](https://substack.com/redirect/a31fff20-5881-4249-8644-80a63f8a6f17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the International Organization for Migration. Almost half of those have fled Taiz governorate, which encompasses some of Yemen's highest mountains and a large stretch of the western Red Sea coastal plain approaching the Bab al-Mandab, including the strategic port of Mokha. Aid agencies cannot reach more than 600,000 people in Taiz--where the capital city is currently besieged by Ansarallah--who depend on humanitarian assistance, according to the UN's World Food Program (WFP), including more than 200,000 women and children.
[READ MORE: Encircled by War, Yemen's Taiz Residents Brace for Fighting and a Renewed Siege](https://substack.com/redirect/228b8d22-9941-45f4-990c-42c3a464f60d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## **A Web of War**
The UAE is Israel's closest ally in the Gulf, and was previously allied with Saudi Arabia in its war against Ansarallah in Yemen. But the UAE's interests in Yemen diverge from both Israel's and Saudi Arabia's.
As early as 2015 it became apparent that the Emirates' priority in Yemen was to counter the perceived threat from the Muslim Brotherhood over and above the conflict with Ansarallah. The Islah Party--Yemen's political Islamist party that includes factions of the Muslim Brotherhood--emerged as the UAE's primary target despite their role within the IRG.
In 2015, UAE forces and Yemeni fighters it trained and funded pushed Houthi forces--that at the time included loyalists of Yemen's former president Ali Abdullah Saleh--out of the southern city of Aden. The UAE went on to consolidate its gains, establishing an array of fighting groups that they both funded and directed.
The STC represented the aspiration for renewed southern independence and animosity in the region toward being ruled by northern elites since the unification of Yemen in 1990. Unification resulted in land theft and the economic benefits of the south's natural resources being captured by Saleh and his cronies. Islah was also viewed by southerners as part of this exploitative northern rule.
The UAE capitalized on this animosity and desire for self-determination, supporting the creation in May 2017 of the separatist Southern Transitional Council (STC) led by Aidarous al-Zubaidi. Islah was a common enemy.
Between 2015 and 2018 at least 160 assassinations were carried out in southern Yemen. The majority of those assassinated were members of Islah, many of them were imams, creating a climate of fear and paranoia in Aden and across the south. Widely held suspicion that the UAE was behind the deaths was confirmed in 2018 when American mercenaries told a[ BuzzFeed](https://substack.com/redirect/3314696a-280a-4742-963e-51167925c002?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) journalist (and, later,[ the BBC](https://substack.com/redirect/f6195854-3ab1-4c46-b72a-2299895d6227?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) that they had carried out assassinations on behalf of the UAE and trained Yemeni forces to carry on the killings.
Ansaf Ali Mayo, an Islah parliamentarian, survived an attempt on his life by the American assassins. Earlier this year he[ filed a lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/eb160abd-b927-412b-bc57-8f946235b14d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the two former U.S. special forces operators in a federal court in San Diego along with the Israeli-Hungarian founder of the private security firm Spear Operations Group that hired them.
The UAE's hiring of foreign mercenaries didn't stop at U.S. veterans. Thousands of Sudanese Rapid Support Force (RSF) were brought in by the UAE between 2015 and 2018 to help fight Ansarallah as the UAE-backed forces made gains up Yemen's western Red Sea coast into the governorate of Hodeidah, home to Yemen's second largest port and controlled by Ansarallah.
The rift between UAE-backed forces and those of the Saudi-backed IRG has not only considerably weakened efforts against the Houthis but, on several occasions over the past decade, spilled into direct infighting.
In August 2019, UAE fighter jets carried out up to 24 airstrikes [against IRG](https://substack.com/redirect/2de497cf-9820-4cf5-a2dd-c774519e5bc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Islah-aligned government military units and positions in Aden, Abyan, and Marib[ in support of the STC](https://substack.com/redirect/95b988b5-709f-4fd7-9684-22f43398ebf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as the competing factions[ vied for control](https://substack.com/redirect/1e6fa4ca-a6fa-48ee-85b7-bd05c3c942e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Al-Zubaidi was summoned to the Saudi capital and in November 2019, an agreement was signed between the Saudi-backed IRG and the STC.
The power-sharing deal, known as the Riyadh Agreement, should have meant an integration of STC forces into the IRG military in exchange for southern representation in a unity government. But implementation stalled.
The situation came to a head in December 2025 when STC forces swept east from their stronghold in Aden to take two large governorates bordering Saudi Arabia and Oman. Saudi Arabia responded by launching airstrikes targeting a large shipment of Emirati military equipment at the port of Mukalla and giving the UAE 24 hours to leave and end its "military or financial support to any party within Yemen." The UAE heeded the warnings and STC forces were quickly routed by Yemeni government military units backed by Saudi air cover.
"Saudi Arabia was the one that forced the UAE out of the coalition waging war on Yemen in a humiliating manner, effectively shooting itself in the foot," said al-Bukhaiti. "Given this experience, it is only natural that the UAE would refuse to rejoin the Saudi-led coalition in its aggression against Yemen [Ansarallah], despite pressure from Saudi Arabia, the United States, and Israel, particularly after Yemen demonstrated its remarkable ability to defend itself and impose a principle of blockade for blockade and escalation for escalation."
Since this latest fissure between Saudi Arabia and the UAE in Yemen, not all of the formerly UAE-aligned forces have been fully integrated into the IRG military and security apparatus, partially because this process was disrupted due to the renewed fighting with Ansarallah. STC loyalists remain in the mountains of Al Dhale, the homeland of Al-Zubaidi who fled to the UAE in January. For months after the Saudi pushback in December 2025, surveillance drones were a constant presence and Saudi airstrikes killed at least six civilians in Al Dhale in January. A Yemeni source familiar with the STC-Ansarallah communications told Drop Site that channels were being facilitated by a senior STC figure in Al-Dhale.
In an indication of both how the UAE operates in Yemen and sentiment in the south towards the Saudi-backed IRG, when asked by Drop Site which of the fighting groups formerly funded and commanded by the UAE would likely provide intelligence to the Houthis for targeting IRG forces, an individual close to the STC quipped, "probably all of them."
Ansarallah, in recent months, has been remarkably effective at targeting commanders among the Saudi-backed fighters and in anticipating the movements of their forces. Two rounds of precision strikes on October 2 and 7 at the coalition military base west of Aden put this on display. One hit the doorway to the office of the Saudi commander, though he was not present. Another hit brand new military vehicles that were brought to the base a few hours earlier.
The UAE has advanced intelligence gathering capabilities. Established in 2009, the UAE's cybersurveillance Project Raven surveilled alleged militants while also monitoring foreign governments _,_ human rights activists and those critical of the Emirati monarchy. Former U.S. intelligence operatives including former NSA employees were heavily involved in aiding and training the Emiratis, according to an investigation[ by Reuters.](https://substack.com/redirect/9594356b-194b-4f04-b4d9-9a9525cc69a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) By 2013, Reuters reported, the majority of Raven's workforce were Americans. Beginning in 2016, the team used the spying platform Karam to hack into the iPhones of foreign leaders including Turkey's Defense Minister, the Emir of Qatar and Yemeni Nobel Prize-winning political activist Tawakkol Karman.
The UAE is also known to have deployed sophisticated Israeli spyware. In 2021 Amnesty's Pegasus Project investigation determined that the UAE had begun using NSO Group's Pegasus spyware to target members of the Saudi-backed internationally recognized government for surveillance.
Bukhaiti said that the alignment of interests does not mean there is an official alliance between Ansarallah and the UAE. "However, this does not mean that an alliance exists between the UAE and Yemen out of spite toward Saudi Arabia or as a means of settling scores with it. As for reports circulating about an attempt by the UAE to contact us to form an alliance against Saudi Arabia, they are entirely baseless," he said. "Saudi Arabia does not need to beg countries around the world to defend it, nor does it need to worry about the possibility of a future Yemeni-Emirati alliance against it. All it needs to do is agree to end the war and lift the blockade on both sides. This is the only genuine way out of this conflict."
Al-Bukhaiti's reference to "the possibility of a future Yemeni-Emirati alliance" contains a thinly veiled suggestion: Saudi Arabia, he said, need not worry about such an alliance, as long as they end the war and lift the blockade. If they do not do so, however, the potential of such an alliance hangs over the conflict.

I spent yesterday at the University of Georgia doing an event on campus, talking politics with college kids. I love little college towns, and it was a genuinely illuminating day. Here's the good news up front: most of the kids I talked to are voting for Democrats. They're voting for Jon Ossoff. They're voting for Keisha Lance Bottoms.
But the ones I can't stop thinking about are the handful of conservatives who decided to get in my face.
**MAGA Isn 't Dead. But It Is Dying.**
* * *
**Today 's rant is sponsored by Ground News.**
I've been paying more attention to how differently the same story gets covered depending on where you read it--especially lately, when everything feels optimized for speed and outrage instead of context.
Take this one--hundreds of outlets picked up reports of Elon Musk and other billionaire donors giving unprecedented sums to the Republican party in the race up to the midterms.
**The New Republic** states that _Of the 170 billionaire families whose contributions ATF tallied through August 28, 113 gave predominantly to Republicans and only 45 gave predominantly to Democrats._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd35963-4861-49af-b259-aa15a6d89b5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**100% FED UP!** says _Senate Democrats are spending borrowed cash to widen their battlefield. Musk is financing an outside Republican turnout machine with checks large enough to alter the shape of that battlefield._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd35963-4861-49af-b259-aa15a6d89b5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Same story--completely different narratives.

That's why I use Ground News. It pulls together 50,000+ sources so you can compare coverage side by side, see political bias, who owns the sources you're reading, how reliable they are and understand how framing changes the story.

[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/0526d056-a530-43f0-abc1-92242a974f24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
There was a group frat guys standing in the back of the outdoor space, snickering the whole time. At one point I baited them into coming up to the mic. And they did. And they did exactly what you'd predict. They immediately asked me how many genders I think there are. They asked me how I felt about gender affirming care as aform of child genital mutilation. It was juvenile, and it was exactly what you'd expect from the best and brightest of a broken, fractured movement that can only focus on a handful of incredibly stupid things. It was very, very 2024.
Not one of these MAGA kids had a question about the economy. Not one had a question about the illegal war Donald Trump would love to ship them off to fight. Nothing about the corruption. They wanted to talk about dumb, stupid culture war bullshit.
And that, friends, sums up the Republican Party's entire closing argument.
Most Republicans already believe the House is gone. The Senate is the last big thing in play, so look at how they're fighting for it. In Michigan, they're making fun of Abdul El-Sayed's name, lying about ties to the Muslim Brotherhood, and calling him a 'radical communist jihadist', the same garbage they threw at Barack Obama and anybody else whose name sounds funny to Midwestern white people. It isn't working.
In South Carolina, Annie Andrews made a race competitive that was never supposed to be, so they're dumping millions into bailing out Darline Graham, who I'm not sure could find her own state on a map, let alone Taiwan or Ukraine. Donald Trump's big solution is to call her "Trannie Annie" and lie that she wants to pull your kids out of school for transgender surgery.
And in Ohio, Vivek Ramaswamy went after Amy Acton by putting her estranged mother in an ad, a woman who lost custody of Amy at 12 for staying with her own daughter's rapist.
That's the playbook everywhere you look. Name-calling. Race-baiting. Demonizing kids. Even if you don't agree with what's happening to trans kids, even if you don't love that trans people exist, we should be hugging our kids and making them feel safe and loved no matter their circumstances. Instead, they're using them as props.
They'll talk about anything other than the economy, the war, and the massive corruption inside this administration, so they're throwing spaghetti at the wall and hoping something gets their base off the couch. Sometimes that works, especially when they're out of power and their voters need something to be angry about, someone other than their own representatives to blame for their problems. But you can't gaslight people like this when the economy is this bad.
* * *
I've started paying more attention to how the same story can feel completely different depending on who's reporting it. Ground News makes that easy to see by showing coverage from across the political spectrum and pointing out what certain outlets leave out.
My team and I use it because it helps cut through the noise.
**[See every side of every story with Ground News->](https://substack.com/redirect/0526d056-a530-43f0-abc1-92242a974f24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
_Try it today!_
[ Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/0526d056-a530-43f0-abc1-92242a974f24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
You know exactly what I mean. You feel it every time you fill up your tank. You feel it in the grocery checkout line. You feel it if you've ever sat with your partner and done the math on buying a house and realized it isn't happening. That daily indignity wears on you. And then you turn on the TV and the President of the United States is babbling about a golden age, bragging about how much money he's making, and pivoting to some culture war fight you never think about.
It doesn't work anymore. Marjorie Taylor Greene called it late-stage MAGA, and she's right. It's pathetic. Truly pathetic.
Nate Silver wrote in the last couple of days that this election is the end of MAGA. I don't think that's quite right. Trump still has two more years in office. What we're watching is the beginning of the end, not the end itself. And here's what I'm certain of: it's going to get weirder, sadder, more pathetic, and more dangerous from here, because a cornered, wounded animal is always more dangerous than a healthy one. We should go in with our eyes open.
But this is what the beginning of the end looks like, no matter what happens on Tuesday. I think we take back the Senate. Even if we fall short, this is still a massive rejection of everything they're selling. And if the bottom really falls out? If we get to 53 seats and start winning places like Kansas, Mississippi, and South Carolina? Who knows how far this goes.
Trump will loom over the Republican Party for years. The rest of the country is going to move on much faster than they think. Those guys snickering in the back of that crowd in Athens? That's what's left of their movement. Loud, smug, and talking about everything except the lives people are actually living. We're the ones who get to decide what comes next.
So this week, run through a brick wall. I'm in New York right now, away from my family, doing as much media as I can to push us across the finish line, and I'll keep writing and shooting videos the whole way. Do everything you can to elect as many Democrats as you can.
I love you. Stay safe out there. Because we know they're going to try to fuck with this election at the end, and our job is to make the wave too big for it to work.
With urgency,
--Mike

Even if you don't agree with what's happening to trans kids, even if you don't love that trans people exist, we should be hugging our kids and making them feel safe and loved no matter their circumstances. Instead, they're using them as props. They'll talk about anything other than the economy, the war, and the massive corruption inside this administration, so they're throwing spaghetti at the wall and hoping something gets their base off the couch. Sometimes that works, especially when they're out of power and their voters need something to be angry about, someone other than their own representatives to blame for their problems. But you can't gaslight people like this when the economy is this bad. I've started paying more attention to how the same story can feel completely different depending on who's reporting it. Ground News makes that easy to see by showing coverage from across the political spectrum and pointing out what certain outlets leave out. My team and I use it because it helps cut through the noise. Try it today! You know exactly what I mean. You feel it every time you fill up your tank. You feel it in the grocery checkout line. You feel it if you've ever sat with your partner and done the math on buying a house and realized it isn't happening. That daily indignity wears on you. And then you turn on the TV and the President of the United States is babbling about a golden age, bragging about how much money he's making, and pivoting to some culture war fight you never think about. It doesn't work anymore. Marjorie Taylor Greene called it late-stage MAGA, and she's right. It's pathetic. Truly pathetic. Nate Silver wrote in the last couple of days that this election is the end of MAGA. I don't think that's quite right. Trump still has two more years in office. What we're watching is the beginning of the end, not the end itself. And here's what I'm certain of: it's going to get weirder, sadder, more pathetic, and more dangerous from here, because a cornered, wounded animal is always more dangerous than a healthy one. We should go in with our eyes open. But this is what the beginning of the end looks like, no matter what happens on Tuesday. I think we take back the Senate. Even if we fall short, this is still a massive rejection of everything they're selling. And if the bottom really falls out? If we get to 53 seats and start winning places like Kansas, Mississippi, and South Carolina? Who knows how far this goes. Trump will loom over the Republican Party for years. The rest of the country is going to move on much faster than they think. Those guys snickering in the back of that crowd in Athens? That's what's left of their movement. Loud, smug, and talking about everything except the lives people are actually living. We're the ones who get to decide what comes next. So this week, run through a brick wall. I'm in New York right now, away from my family, doing as much media as I can to push us across the finish line, and I'll keep writing and shooting videos the whole way. Do everything you can to elect as many Democrats as you can. I love you. Stay safe out there. Because we know they're going to try to fuck with this election at the end, and our job is to make the wave too big for it to work. subject: Elections, protecting kids, and more from Oregon DOJ

See if you're owed money from recent prescription drug settlements

# We’re fighting for Oregon communities.
Election Day is a week away on Nov. 3, and **Oregonians can be confident our elections will be safe, secure, and accurate – and Oregon DOJ is prepared to respond if any issues arise.** **Meanwhile, our daily work continues:** investigating scams & fraud, protecting Oregon kids, fighting for our environment, and getting money back in the pockets of working families when pharmaceutical companies make prescription drug prices too high. Our office is working every day to serve you. Read on for more, and as always, feel free to reach out to our office directly with questions or concerns. Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General
---

# AG Rayfield: “Our elections have integrity.”
Ballots are out, and our office is remaining vigilant: **if any threats to our elections occur, we will immediately take action.** Last month, our coalition secured a [major win protecting mail-in voting](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.kgw.com%2Farticle%2Fnews%2Fpolitics%2Fnational-politics%2Foregon-washington-elected-leaders-us-supreme-court-rejection-trump-administration-mail-in-voting-restrictions%2F283-4ee6980e-fa37-4343-95ee-287dd9518e5b/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/8aO02Gv7MDRYy2YP6iDByqNLwR90054uvIAY5ypAyzA=452) at the US Supreme Court. As a result, voting by mail will happen in Oregon as it has for 25+ years. We also recently spoke with [CBS News](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv=xyeyQfgw24s%26t=25s/2/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/Msp8aDclY5S_qor7ms3qY5vjCGSdKz0g2yUL3899cXs=452) about our work to make sure Oregon's elections continue to have integrity. **If you**’** re a registered voter in Oregon, be sure to return your ballot by 8pm on Tuesday, November 3. **[Click here](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fsos.oregon.gov%2Felections%2FPages%2Fdefault.aspx/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/vLunoLukcsqPy32W61YplIXdrAkS-MI62LtXiO6ZfSg=452) for voting information from the Oregon Secretary of State, including how to find a dropbox.

# Taking action to keep Oregon kids safe
**Our kids deserve to feel safe at school, at home, and online.** That’s why we’re taking a comprehensive look at social media companies and AI technologies that have the power to harm kids, including their use by extremists to encourage kids to commit violent acts. [Read more. ](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.opb.org%2Farticle%2F2026%2F10%2F20%2Finvestigators-probe-bend-gunmans-connection-to-violent-extremist-groups%2F/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/4cgDRhetapAjHxnFF4R0bsxFHncWLH5QrD2M_fnuHr4=452) **When companies put kids in harm’s way, we’ll hold them accountable.** Stay tuned for more.

# You may be owed money from recent prescription drug settlements
**We’ve recently had several big settlements holding drug manufacturers accountable for illegally driving up costs of prescription drugs –** and there’s a [website](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Faggenericdrugs.com%2F/2/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/sPV1LCNwABXXI8V7bWVu1FUGvpUYlD07vGqiwHJxnWU=452) where you can check whether you’ve been impacted or are eligible for compensation. See if you’re owed money from recent prescription drug settlements at [AGGenericDrugs.com](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Faggenericdrugs.com%2F/3/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/AmuWWidV7-3_f-CGkUcZCp9gVsXAFqHwmD-b7vpSTK4=452).

# What you need to know about scams & fraud
Scammers are targeting Oregonians across the state, including a recent [jury duty scam](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fshare%2Fp%2F1BhZnjFJwj%2F/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/KmYd_Jb3DbriDtxuXJ6O0EXgpSFC3WZN6PeQmDo7_JU=452) impersonating judges or sheriffs. Remember: government officials will never call you to demand money because you allegedly missed jury duty, ask you to meet, or require sensitive personal information via phone or email. **Our team is here to help if you've been impacted by a scam.** Call the Oregon DOJ Consumer Hotline at 1-877-877-9392 or file a complaint online [here.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fconsumer-protection%2Fsales-scams-fraud%2Freport-scams-fraud%2F/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/3mdMeHgEQ_ke86Cf_G0LS4aViwE1RvA-dLEXfyKakK0=452)

# Taking action to protect our environment
We recently pushed back against two attempts by the Trump administration to roll back environmental protections: one for fossil fuel power plants, and one for vehicle efficiency standards. [Learn more about why these legal actions matter.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fyoutube.com%2Fshorts%2FQwxF9fnslzU/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/83fo9EGRWtPzKp4no2t33GneRe3El9hakhYnfnFdsAM=452) See the latest on our federal oversight work [here](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Foregon-department-of-justice%2Ffederal-oversight%2Ffederal-litigation-tracker%2F/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/a5KPsP0AAsZwvB4k2dRhvlcVtIekeo6vfQgktc_7G30=452).

# Making government more accessible & transparent
**We launched[Open Door to Government](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Foregon-department-of-justice%2Fopen-door-to-government%2F/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/3ImX7erIqlk6h6muGm6zU3hMUSBxjpCbNknK3aSLhok=452) to help make government more accessible and transparent for Oregonians. ** In the [“DOJ and Me” Toolkit](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Foregon-department-of-justice%2Fopen-door-to-government%2Fdoj-and-me%2F/1/010101a17f2cfc75-06288e7e-5f14-4ded-b9b7-1d9108a28fc0-000000/rYPiKVciO5SsivLVSq9t2BBvdhUbC9PCkBaaOOSgvWU=452), you can learn more about what the Oregon Attorney General does, how the Oregon DOJ serves Oregonians, and answers to frequently asked questions.

clean_body: See if you're owed money from recent prescription drug settlements | | | | | We’re fighting for Oregon communities. Election Day is a week away on Nov. 3, and Oregonians can be confident our elections will be safe, secure, and accurate – and Oregon DOJ is prepared to respond if any issues arise. Meanwhile, our daily work continues: investigating scams & fraud, protecting Oregon kids, fighting for our environment, and getting money back in the pockets of working families when pharmaceutical companies make prescription drug prices too high. Our office is working every day to serve you. Read on for more, and as always, feel free to reach out to our office directly with questions or concerns. Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General | | | AG Rayfield: “Our elections have integrity.” Ballots are out, and our office is remaining vigilant: if any threats to our elections occur, we will immediately take action. Last month, our coalition secured a at the US Supreme Court. As a result, voting by mail will happen in Oregon as it has for 25+ years. We also recently spoke with about our work to make sure Oregon's elections continue to have integrity. If you’ re a registered voter in Oregon, be sure to return your ballot by 8pm on Tuesday, November 3. for voting information from the Oregon Secretary of State, including how to find a dropbox. | | | Taking action to keep Oregon kids safe Our kids deserve to feel safe at school, at home, and online. That’s why we’re taking a comprehensive look at social media companies and AI technologies that have the power to harm kids, including their use by extremists to encourage kids to commit violent acts. When companies put kids in harm’s way, we’ll hold them accountable. Stay tuned for more. | | | You may be owed money from recent prescription drug settlements We’ve recently had several big settlements holding drug manufacturers accountable for illegally driving up costs of prescription drugs – and there’s a where you can check whether you’ve been impacted or are eligible for compensation. See if you’re owed money from recent prescription drug settlements at . | | | What you need to know about scams & fraud Scammers are targeting Oregonians across the state, including a recent impersonating judges or sheriffs. Remember: government officials will never call you to demand money because you allegedly missed jury duty, ask you to meet, or require sensitive personal information via phone or email. Our team is here to help if you've been impacted by a scam. Call the Oregon DOJ Consumer Hotline at 1-877-877-9392 or file a complaint online | | | Taking action to protect our environment We recently pushed back against two attempts by the Trump administration to roll back environmental protections: one for fossil fuel power plants, and one for vehicle efficiency standards. See the latest on our federal oversight work . | | | Making government more accessible & transparent We launched to help make government more accessible and transparent for Oregonians. In the , you can learn more about what the Oregon Attorney General does, how the Oregon DOJ serves Oregonians, and answers to frequently asked questions. | | | We want to hear from you! Email us at mailto:AttorneyGeneral@doj.oregon.gov or call 503-378-6002 with questions, comments, or concerns. Our founding fathers watched Europe tear itself apart over state religions for centuries, and they wanted something better for their new country.
So they opened the First Amendment with sixteen words:
“Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion, or prohibiting the free exercise thereof.”
Every faith is free to flourish, and no faith is allowed to rule.
Millions of believers have crossed oceans since, trusting those sixteen words with their lives.
Extremists like Keith Self are the loudest self-declared patriots in Washington.
They quote the Constitution at every rally but hypocritically cross out whatever gets in Trump’s way.
As a veteran and a congressman, Keith Self swore an oath to the whole document.
Somewhere between the far right Freedom Caucus conference and the green room at Fox News, his oath got lost.
I believe in that document the way the founders wrote it. I gave it 20 years in uniform.
Last Sunday morning I worshipped at McKinney First Baptist.
Sunday afternoon I stood with hundreds of our Sikh neighbors at the Gurdwara in Richardson.
Over the next couple days I also had the privilege of meeting with members of the Hindu and Muslim communities.

clean_body: 7 days to show Texas what service before self looks like. | | Peter, We have 7 days left to show Texas that service before self beats spite and stunts every time. And we're not letting our foot off the gas. Because Keith Self is unsurprisingly spending his closing arguments manufacturing lies about our neighbors instead of making any case for himself. He just gave an interview that should have been spent answering for the failures of his term. The grocery prices that never came down. The war Congress never approved. Instead he rambled on about the made-up danger of " making the Senate Muslim." Self co-founded an entire congressional caucus around the fantasy that Sharia law is coming for Collin County. All that fearmongering leaves no time for actual work, which explains why our district has so little to show for his term. So I did an interview that gave the voters of this district an ACTUAL closing argument, a promise I will keep. When I get to Congress, I will do all I can to discredit and disband his Anti-Sharia Caucus, because targeting Americans over how they dress or worship is fundamentally un-American. | Our founding fathers watched Europe tear itself apart over state religions for centuries, and they wanted something better for their new country. So they opened the First Amendment with sixteen words: “Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion, or prohibiting the free exercise thereof.” Every faith is free to flourish, and no faith is allowed to rule. Millions of believers have crossed oceans since, trusting those sixteen words with their lives. Extremists like Keith Self are the loudest self-declared patriots in Washington. They quote the Constitution at every rally but hypocritically cross out whatever gets in Trump’s way. As a veteran and a congressman, Keith Self swore an oath to the whole document. Somewhere between the far right Freedom Caucus conference and the green room at Fox News, his oath got lost. I believe in that document the way the founders wrote it. I gave it 20 years in uniform. Last Sunday morning I worshipped at McKinney First Baptist. Sunday afternoon I stood with hundreds of our Sikh neighbors at the Gurdwara in Richardson. Over the next couple days I also had the privilege of meeting with members of the Hindu and Muslim communities. | I believe there is incredible beauty in the diversity of faith representation, and being able to experience what is sacred to your neighbors is a gift. Americans worship in a thousand different ways, and the same sixteen words protect every one of them. A congressman should love that about America. Keith Self wages war on it. ## **Why did you marry your brother?**
Eight years later, federal agents have searched Omar's home, investigators have reportedly obtained DNA evidence to determine whether her ex-husband is her biological brother, and the government's own court filings refer to her as "Ilhan Nur Said Elmi" - the same name as the man she married. The left-wing media is treating it like breaking news, but it has taken the media and the Justice Department nearly a decade to catch up to Laura Loomer's reporting.
On August 11, 2018, Loomer confronted Omar and Michigan congressional candidate Rashida Tlaib at a joint campaign event at a Minneapolis deli. The [Star Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/09bc08eb-7a27-4693-bfee-da544dd4b36a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) called it "crashing" the event. On video, Loomer [asked Omar why she married her brother](https://substack.com/redirect/0baa7f76-0e35-4893-8dac-153f2857db01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and told her, "Ilhan, it is illegal to use your campaign finance funds to pay for your divorce from your brother!"

Facebook unpublished Loomer's page within hours of her posting the video. Three months later, after Omar won her seat, Twitter [banned Loomer](https://substack.com/redirect/f8c7a96b-bc9a-4c4e-84ef-70702ece8b2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for criticizing her. That July, Loomer Unleashed [reminded readers](https://substack.com/redirect/2a23c703-5bfb-4437-ba0f-ab151abb6962?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of everything it had uncovered about Omar's marriage to Ahmed Nur Said Elmi. And last December, Loomer Unleashed asked Omar to her face whether she [married her own brother to steal citizenship](https://substack.com/redirect/e7bb3b16-ba2f-4b10-a6a8-3703ccadfaf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and Omar melted down.
For eight years, the media's answer was to call it a smear campaign or "Islamophobia." PolitiFact ran a piece in 2019 [relaying her hometown newspaper's conclusion](https://substack.com/redirect/c13155f3-e179-47a2-825b-78ae7ebdee08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). As recently as last December, Snopes declared the story a "[rumor](https://substack.com/redirect/27e3957a-9575-4288-a495-86121967059a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" that "lacks evidence." The so-called fact-checkers never asked Omar the hard questions, and apparently neither did any US law enforcement agency.
Then, on October 12, Homeland Security Investigations agents [executed a court-authorized search warrant](https://substack.com/redirect/bd3973e5-dd9f-4116-97ba-dfc40eb75303?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at Omar's home in Washington, D.C., as part of what the Justice Department calls an ongoing federal criminal investigation. Officials have described it as a multiyear immigration fraud probe built in part on whistleblower complaints. Once again, Laura Loomer broke the news on X that morning:

Laura Loomer has been saying all of this for years. According to [The Wall Street Journal](https://substack.com/redirect/c2022b51-9c74-4fc8-91f1-b8318ec60c29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the probe includes how Omar obtained her U.S. citizenship after arriving from Somalia, including paperwork filed by her late father and whether her age was recorded as 17 instead of 18, a difference that matters for automatic citizenship. Her father, Nur Omar Mohamed, was reportedly a colonel in Somali dictator Siad Barre's military, and an Oxford historian [told the New York Post](https://substack.com/redirect/da6b913a-07e9-4e2e-bb81-9f94e3433a0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it is "very wrong for the United States to host war criminals."
Federal agents have [reportedly obtained DNA evidence](https://substack.com/redirect/b99828a5-dfde-4105-a962-70ddb5dc1b50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to determine whether Elmi is her biological brother. One source told the New York Post the DNA is "critical" to the case, and two sources said the evidence gives prosecutors "a solid basis" to take an immigration fraud conspiracy case to a grand jury. Applications to unseal materials tied to the search warrant [identify the target](https://substack.com/redirect/0848e14f-fcb2-4e05-a2cf-23fbeac1662e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as "Congresswoman Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, a.k.a. Ilhan Abdullahi Omar." Nur Said Elmi is the same name as the man she married.
This investigation didn't start under President Trump. It started under Joe Biden. According to [The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/2af1a14c-14a6-44f2-b3fc-1e06b403e7ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), federal prosecutors in Washington and the Justice Department's Public Integrity Section opened an inquiry into Omar's finances, campaign spending, and contacts with a foreign national in June 2024 under Merrick Garland. Even CNN's own legal analyst, former federal prosecutor Elie Honig, [admitted on air](https://substack.com/redirect/d2790266-f1bb-40c9-8cf4-56ace5424396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the probe began under the Biden administration and was reopened under Trump. Biden's DOJ got there six years after Loomer did.
The courts haven't rubber-stamped anything. The warrant was signed by a magistrate judge in Washington, D.C. who [reportedly donated to Hillary Clinton](https://substack.com/redirect/484e2024-c6c8-40f1-8854-24f0038a8a45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2016, hardly a MAGA Republican. According to [CBS News](https://substack.com/redirect/9466653f-737a-4b4e-b6fa-aa6bebf7a078?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), prosecutors first presented the warrant to the judge about a week before the search, and the two went through a "lengthy back-and-forth" before it was approved. The judge even added protections for Omar's legislative privileges as a member of Congress. Search warrants are routinely signed off on quickly, even in cases involving violent crime. This one got extended scrutiny from a left-leaning judge who still found probable cause to search a sitting congresswoman's home.
Omar is crying foul even though she spent years insisting that "[no one is above the law](https://substack.com/redirect/cbe31fdc-31a0-408c-aade-a16ae4a79e27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and that her opponents and the media could investigate all they want. Now she says she lives "paycheck to paycheck" and drives a 2016 Camry, despite financial disclosures that once listed up to $30 million in assets.
At this stage of the investigation nothing has been proven in court - not the marriage fraud, and not the allegations that she used her position to [massively enrich herself](https://substack.com/redirect/149533c4-2412-4a5f-b19d-97da4eef6202?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In our country, we believe that someone is innocent until proven guilty, even someone who hates the country that saved her life.
What we do know is that Omar [used campaign funds to pay her son](https://substack.com/redirect/96768471-7df9-488d-9040-f51c9da2ad85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), refused to back a [Muslim Brotherhood](https://substack.com/redirect/44170011-6d98-4bce-90f5-713531f28f1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) terror probe, refused to recognize the [Armenian Genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/dcdfbccd-e745-4620-b6a0-cf5a5b4bea65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and described the 9/11 hijackers as "[some people](https://substack.com/redirect/f24bec59-d690-48c7-bf12-512ce98de84c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
Why are Democrats so desperate to paint a legitimate investigation that began under Biden and was approved by a Clinton-donor judge as a political hit job? Because that's the point. Every time they smear a lawful investigation as "weaponization," they chip away at public trust in the agents who enforce our laws and secure our borders.
This is the same party that spent years chanting "Defund the police" and "Abolish ICE." They can't win those fights at the ballot box, so they fight them in the court of public opinion instead. If immigration fraud by a sitting member of Congress can be waved away as persecution, then no immigration fraud case is safe, and neither is the agency charged with bringing them. Undermining Homeland Security Investigations over Ilhan Omar isn't a side effect of the Democrats' outrage. It is the goal.
Laura Loomer was banned, mocked, and called a conspiracy theorist and anti-Muslim bigot for years for asking Ilhan Omar about marrying her brother. Eight years later, the federal government is asking the same question. With the midterms one week away, voters deserve to know who was right all along and which party is still trying to protect Ilhan Omar from the answer and accountability.

Eight years later, the federal government is asking the same question. With the midterms one week away, voters deserve to know who was right all along and which party is still trying to protect Ilhan Omar from the answer and accountability. name: Chris Pappas
subject: I need to be transparent with you
body:
[1]LeftNet

It’s Chris.

I wish I didn’t have to write this email, but I need to be transparent
with you about what we’re up against:

Right now we’re being outspent 3:1.

For every dollar our campaign is putting into reaching voters, Republicans
and their outside groups are spending three times as much to flood New
Hampshire’s airwaves with attack ads.

National GOP groups are pouring millions into the Granite State because
they know what happens here could decide control of the Senate.

Their strategy is simple: spend as much as they can, as fast as they can,
and try to drown out our message to voters.

But Granite Staters don’t let outside groups decide their elections. They
want to hear directly from candidates. They want to know who will fight to
lower costs, protect reproductive freedom, and deliver results for their
families.

That’s why we need to make sure our campaign message can break
through.

Our campaign is powered by grassroots supporters – people who believe New
Hampshire deserves a senator who answers to them, not Washington insiders
or special interests.

Non-Contribution Account (For TTPAC, Inc.'s Expenditures Other Than Direct Contributions to Federal Committees)

Contributions to this account may be used to influence federal elections by making independent expenditures in support of or in opposition to federal candidates. Individuals, federal committees, corporations, and labor unions may contribute to TTPAC, Inc.'s non-contribution account without limit. Contributions by national banks, foreign nationals (without lawful permanent resident status), and other foreign entities (e.g., foreign corporations) are prohibited. clean_body: This will come as a surprise to some. | Peter, I've been watching elections for a LONG time. I started all the way back in 1956 with the Dwight Eisenhower-Adlai Stevenson presidential race! Yes, Republicans are locked in tight races in red states like Texas, Ohio, and Iowa. But we're also within the margin of error in Minnesota and Maine! To put it simply, I've never seen a map like this before. I know the generic ballot polls show the Democrats winning by a lot. But how many times have polls shown a Democrat landslide only to be proven wrong? For as long as I can remember, I have carried a question I could barely say out loud: I wonder if the government killed my father.
He was born in a refugee camp in Russia during the war, and spent his first nine years in a deportation camp in Germany. Whatever a childhood is supposed to be, his was rationed by other people's wars: a decade in camps, then a crossing to California, where the war was something that had happened somewhere else. He grew up. He went to San Francisco State. He served in the Army Reserves. In 1977 he died of leukemia at thirty-seven. I was six.
That is the arithmetic of my father: ten years in camps, twenty in California, and a disease that took him before I could know him. For 50 years the question was only a shape in the dark. Then this month I read a story about a newspaper, and the question got a name, a date, and a declassified file.
Three days before Christmas 1976, a lawyer named Edward Nevin III stood on a BART platform, newspaper in hand, and saw a headline: "Army Tested Biological War in S.F." From that page he learned what had killed his grandfather a quarter century earlier. In late September 1950, the Army sent a minesweeper a few miles off the Golden Gate and, for six days, sprayed the city with Serratia marcescens -- a bacterium its officials believed harmless -- to measure how a bioweapon attack on a port city might spread. Army monitors caught the cloud in Colma, Daly City, Sausalito, Albany, Berkeley, Oakland, San Leandro. By the Army's own estimate, nearly everyone in San Francisco inhaled five thousand particles a minute, for hours. Within days, Stanford Hospital -- which in its history had never seen a Serratia infection -- had eleven. One of them, a seventy-five-year-old retired PG&E man named Edward Nevin, died. His family learned why from a newspaper, twenty-six years later. When they sued, a judge ruled there wasn't enough proof the test killed him. The proof was classified.

Hey there, it’s Mallory McMorrow. In case you missed it, I'm relaunching **A More Perfect Michigan** to fund the candidates in 16 races that will decide control of the Michigan legislature this November. Our goal is simple: **grow our Democratic majority in the state Senate and flip the state House.** Almost everything that determines whether an election is free and fair is decided at the state level. Not by Congress. Not by the President. By state legislatures — 7,383 people nationwide, most of whom you couldn't name, in races most of us skip past on the ballot. Back in 2022, I started A More Perfect Michigan with what felt like an absurd goal: flip the state Senate for the first time in my lifetime. **And we did it.** We flipped the Senate and delivered Michigan's first Democratic trifecta in nearly forty years. Then we governed like we give a damn — passing more bills into law in six months than the previous six legislatures _combined_. We repealed Michigan's 1931 abortion ban. Raised the minimum wage. Expanded civil rights and voting rights. Made sure every kid in Michigan gets breakfast and lunch at school. Passed the strongest gun safety laws in our state's history. We lost the state House by a handful of seats in 2024. We got a Republican House Speaker who models himself as a Donald Trump impersonator, trying to break government from the inside. Everything slowed down. Dr. Pan is now running for Congress in California’s 6th Congressional District — a critical pickup seat as we work to retake the House. name: Sen. Jacky Rosen
subject: I'm leading the charge in the Senate to combat antisemitism
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
We must stop the epidemic of antisemitic violence and harassment.
| | |
---
Friend,
I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue President ever elected to the United States Senate. Think about that: In our nation’s 250-year history, there were only TWO Jewish women elected to the Senate before I joined.
Like any believer, my faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker. It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. Most prominently, the threat and impact of antisemitism.
**That's why I'm leading the charge in the Senate to combat the increasing levels of violence and harassment Jewish Americans are facing right now.**
[**_Will you please make a gift of $5 or more to support my work in Washington to fight the epidemic of antisemitism across our country?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142321505/656533306/910177728?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5954-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTBiMjE3OS01MmQyLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJkNTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QGhl1839nhsfb3bG4FfcAW80q38B24RWzGtDZScbwHA=)

---
For me, this fight is personal. When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a hotel swimming pool with my mom while on vacation when a lifeguard on duty told her that we were “dirty” because we were Jewish – and that we had to leave the pool immediately because of it. My parents packed up our things and left that hotel. We never returned. My mom never forgot that interaction, retelling the story for years.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142321507/656533308/-1995338237?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5954-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTBiMjE3OS01MmQyLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJkNTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QGhl1839nhsfb3bG4FfcAW80q38B24RWzGtDZScbwHA=)
Nearly every Jewish American has a moment in their lives when they experience or witness antisemitism like that firsthand, and the problem is especially serious today.
Swastika graffiti. Physical assaults and threats. Firebombings. **Multiple** deadly mass shootings. These attacks on Jews are not isolated incidents. They represent a regression toward one of civilization’s darkest chapters.
All of it is wrong, and addressing this kind of violent antisemitism is an issue I’ve been working on since before I came to Congress and throughout my time in the House and Senate. **That is why:**
* I founded the Senate’s first-ever Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism, which now includes more than half the Senate as members.

* I introduced the _Jewish American Security Act –_ sweeping legislation to fight antisemitism on college campuses, at Jewish communal institutions, and online. The bill is supported by the American Jewish Committee, the ADL, and the Jewish Council for Public Affairs.

* I successfully pushed the Biden administration to create the first-ever National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism, which took a whole-of-government approach to tackling rising hate.

* I led the effort in Congress to increase the power of the State Department’s Special Envoy to Monitor and Combat Antisemitism by raising the position to the rank of Ambassador.

* I introduced and successfully helped pass legislation reauthorizing the _Never Again Education Act_ to educate communities about the Holocaust.

* I successfully pressured the Trump administration to avoid weakening Coast Guard standards for hate symbols like swastikas.

When I think about this work, I think about being that little girl with her mom again. Every day, I'm trying to help make our country a place where nobody is targeted because of their faith or who they are – whether it’s at a swimming pool, on a college campus, or in the United States military.
**This work is more urgent than ever now that Americans across the country are being targeted, attacked, and killed simply because they are Jewish. That's why I'm counting on your support to power my fight today.**[**_Please, make a generous gift of $5 or more now to help me keep fighting in the Senate to make our country safer and more tolerant for all of us._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142321508/656533309/910177728?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5954-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTBiMjE3OS01MmQyLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJkNTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QGhl1839nhsfb3bG4FfcAW80q38B24RWzGtDZScbwHA=)

clean_body: We must stop the epidemic of antisemitic violence and harassment. | | | Friend, I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue President ever elected to the United States Senate. Think about that: In our nation’s 250-year history, there were only TWO Jewish women elected to the Senate before I joined. Like any believer, my faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker. It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. Most prominently, the threat and impact of antisemitism. That's why I'm leading the charge in the Senate to combat the increasing levels of violence and harassment Jewish Americans are facing right now. = | | = For me, this fight is personal. When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a hotel swimming pool with my mom while on vacation when a lifeguard on duty told her that we were “dirty” because we were Jewish – and that we had to leave the pool immediately because of it. My parents packed up our things and left that hotel. We never returned. My mom never forgot that interaction, retelling the story for years. = Nearly every Jewish American has a moment in their lives when they experience or witness antisemitism like that firsthand, and the problem is especially serious today. Swastika graffiti. Physical assaults and threats. Firebombings. Multiple deadly mass shootings. These attacks on Jews are not isolated incidents. They represent a regression toward one of civilization’s darkest chapters. All of it is wrong, and addressing this kind of violent antisemitism is an issue I’ve been working on since before I came to Congress and throughout my time in the House and Senate. That is why: I founded the Senate’s first-ever Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism, which now includes more than half the Senate as members. I introduced the Jewish American Security Act – sweeping legislation to fight antisemitism on college campuses, at Jewish communal institutions, and online. The bill is supported by the American Jewish Committee, the ADL, and the Jewish Council for Public Affairs. I successfully pushed the Biden administration to create the first-ever National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism, which took a whole-of-government approach to tackling rising hate. I led the effort in Congress to increase the power of the State Department’s Special Envoy to Monitor and Combat Antisemitism by raising the position to the rank of Ambassador. I introduced and successfully helped pass legislation reauthorizing the Never Again Education Act to educate communities about the Holocaust. I successfully pressured the Trump administration to avoid weakening Coast Guard standards for hate symbols like swastikas. When I think about this work, I think about being that little girl with her mom again. Every day, I'm trying to help make our country a place where nobody is targeted because of their faith or who they are – whether it’s at a swimming pool, on a college campus, or in the United States military. This work is more urgent than ever now that Americans across the country are being targeted, attacked, and killed simply because they are Jewish. That's why I'm counting on your support to power my fight today.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, friend. subject: Red or blue doesn't matter at the grocery store
body:
I hear it everywhere I go in this district

| |
---
Folks, Being red or blue doesn't matter when gas and groceries are too expensive, and you're struggling to pay your bills. I hear it everywhere I go in this district. Families are watching their grocery bill climb every month, paying more at the pump just to get to work, and making tough choices about which bill to pay first. They don't care whether I'm a Democrat or a Republican. They just want to know if I'm going to do something about it. That's the job, and it's the job I've focused on since the day I took office. I've fought to lower prescription drug costs. I voted for a plan to help reduce housing costs, a measure to eliminate silly tariffs, and to end a war that’s raising the price of fuel. I've pushed to bring federal dollars home for our roads, our transit, and our water systems, so local taxpayers aren't left carrying the bill. I've worked with anyone, from either party, who's serious about easing the pressure on working families. I'm focused on bringing results home for North Jersey, but there are people who would rather make this election about anything else. I'm going to keep making it about the costs families are facing and what we can do to bring them down. ### About Nellie Pou

Adam has traveled all over Kansas listening to the people he hopes to serve and sharing his vision of a government run by people who put service before self, people before politics and country before party. This is what we desperately need in Washington. That’s why Adam’s message caught my eye, and I think that’s why it’s resonating with so many others. How he’s done it is just as remarkable. Adam’s received donations from all 105 counties in Kansas and built his grassroots campaign without accepting a cent from corporate PACs. His opponent, on the other hand, is backed by some of the largest super PACs in the country, who are spending millions to try and save this seat for Sen. Marshall. That’s why Adam urgently needs our help. He has the courage and vision to be a champion for Kansans in the Senate, but it’s up to us to make sure he has the resources to get there, particularly during these final, pivotal days in the race.= Thank you for supporting a leader who I truly believe will do the best for Kansas — and our country. Just like you, he’s tired of the chaos and corruption in Washington that is harming our farmers, raising costs at the checkout line and making critical health care services unattainable. He hears your concerns and is ready to get to work for you. Here’s what Republicans say about this race when they think no one’s listening.
For once, we agree with Ken Paxton.
At a private fundraiser with lobbyists in Washington last month, Paxton was asked about the governor’s race. Here’s what he said, on tape:
**“Yes, Abbott is struggling.”**
[****](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261027_3_ak.NJqn5n&refcode=em20261027-1203&%3Bamount=5&t=2&akid=1203%2E127862%2EbzFs5Q)
_Audio obtained by Rolling Stone_
He went on to admit that even with all of Greg Abbott’s money and name recognition, this race is close. When someone in the room reacted with surprise, Paxton _doubled down._
He’s right. This race is tied.
This is what Republicans say about our campaign when they think no one is listening. In public, they act like this race is a done deal.**In private, they’re telling their donors it’s a fight.**
Greg Abbott has raised over $141 million and spent over $120 million trying to stop us. With just one week until Election Day, he’s going to throw everything he has left at this race.
The only way we answer that is with grassroots support from people like you.
Supporters like you are the reason Ken Paxton is worried and Greg Abbott is struggling. **[Will you split a donation today between Aaron Ford and my campaign so we can finish the job and take Texas back?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261027_3_ak.NJqn5n&amount=5&refcode=em20261027-1189&t=3&akid=1203%2E127862%2EbzFs5Q)**

name: OnePA Team
subject: Our communities deserve the truth about the Iran war
body:
Let’s bring our collective power to the fight for an honest accounting of the lives lost and people wounded in this war. | |
---
Peter, **When we come together to demand investments in our schools, housing, and health care, we’re demanding a say in the decisions that shape our lives. That same power belongs to us when our government sends people to war.** We deserve to know the consequences, and we deserve elected officials willing to answer for them. Right now, the Pentagon is leaving families and communities without a complete accounting of U.S. military casualties connected to the Iran war. The Intercept has documented deaths missing from official totals and wounded service members disappearing from the record without explanation. One government official called the undercounting a “casualty cover-up.” **We know how powerful institutions protect themselves when the people affected have to fight for every answer.** Letting the Pentagon leave these discrepancies unexplained gives the officials running this war even more power over what we’re allowed to know about its costs on our communities. **Our members, our neighbors, and our families have a right to the truth. We’re joining this effort to demand Congress investigate, bring the records into public view, and require an explanation for every person left out of the count.** [**Send a message to Congress demanding an investigation into the Iran war casualty cover-up and a complete public accounting of U.S. military deaths and injuries.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39jrk8_2fFX_qnwxGkMsTuYyq2X7J29yzQ30gFVmKAX5eB-BW0mUXJRGPdZASNrqBUk2mu3KccFxWqWdthSooCussWdQSSh9QmZc0HPL553TsHpwidCUhw2k5jcgCpQPJxhmDRXdzJw8yfQ_lZpu6d3JCZD7MUmLXJQqqaIjERZ1apo8L5a2dM58d2vSEzmIuFvzZu5Nh93f85IzbDyc0YP8VYlKSdoeVd4HMGvdu5AOYHYAkTApL1EW8z6iE3RHGUJ9A1iiMmCxkDS7TI8m0mmmb50W7VfPcZ59e1pdpgf7AXKgNp0kmwt5CjnQtH8MvZt4b_n37W1H_Qx1z5jRZGgPfdkgVPF4FB_BGavHHENwH5hbQT_4rH4nooAR6ZHhVEQr_mpttQQXUu7N9eUJafARIS1mn6vjH6J-zbhcLZPp64Skm6Qt07Ftkrdwmo8b-Sd09tG2X-30JJwlWrNfW6Q/4v8/7wnjw8ERQdWxc52KsUXU_A/h0/h001.EtPfiOmFhrhtrghIhdwi6QEiHoNd77f6ATo46SwiF7E) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39jrk8_2fFX_qnwxGkMsTuYyq2X7J29yzQ30gFVmKAX5eB-BW0mUXJRGPdZASNrqBUk2mu3KccFxWqWdthSooCussWdQSSh9QmZc0HPL553TsHpwidCUhw2k5jcgCpQPJxhmDRXdzJw8yfQ_lZpu6d3JCZD7MUmLXJQqqaIjERZ1apo8L5a2dM58d2vSEzmIuFvzZu5Nh93f85IzbDyc0YPEVpYpNWo-zPZunK6H6CJpEYPXcmQtrNqmg-WSlcGxsPnLd-LRk9Gaj3zM6BkcGsZEWT6rsXKze3mqa9gQjjf5jix6_2SrLMtZ2blRjnmYdIyv3llyvmH_1fSQsDvSluRnCmzGSpIg6-l_iLepjWod5tpGrzgwS03d16y1OPaNezP2ELGA0AzvYFXzbq7qFJ-qpqD0iRpijrReLGyOK5YxGv8pv6sr7IIVVsKclBYI3MA4QMnj4QWmXaoPmCSHISV/4v8/7wnjw8ERQdWxc52KsUXU_A/h1/h001.HefXQ9tq-j9QBBVe-PqiAtlMsVYQ5GwEFv-uUxQh9SU)
---
**One of the people left out of the Pentagon’s count was Major Sorffly Davius, a New York Army National Guard officer who died while deployed in Kuwait during the Iran war.** The military publicly announced his death in March but took more than 6 months to include him in its official war casualty tally. The correction came only after months of questions from The Intercept and 10 articles referencing his death.
His family deserved an accurate accounting from the beginning, and we deserve to know how many others remain missing from the record. We should be able to trust that every person killed or wounded will be counted accurately. When officials fail that basic responsibility, we need our representatives to demand the documents, question those responsible, and establish how many other people have been left out.
**We build power by showing that our communities have a voice wherever decisions about our lives are made. Every message we send puts that demand directly before the members of Congress who represent us.**
[**Tell Congress to investigate the missing casualties, require corrections to the public record, and expose the full human cost of the Iran war.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39jrk8_2fFX_qnwxGkMsTuYyq2X7J29yzQ30gFVmKAX5eB-BW0mUXJRGPdZASNrqBUk2mu3KccFxWqWdthSooCussWdQSSh9QmZc0HPL553TsHpwidCUhw2k5jcgCpQPJxhmDRXdzJw8yfQ_lZpu6d3JCZD7MUmLXJQqqaIjERZ1apo8L5a2dM58d2vSEzmIuFvzZu5Nh93f85IzbDyc0YP2o7Vavo5iWL4XFkW1zm70snc-QCOV690YJKhKhYif9IfilqW3xHoCOoW8grrk8cXMcDa7pKzn4wZn37QT_7xqahvyLjBP6hkYpK_FxAVeYE0ApzHJbMEKtl872JnB8FXlslIJ5c_msEK7wPufqizUI-ZzX-LG2C8WVzZan3Ri3artrYBrpbGjbeCIafXvyrOomcgoDqHK2K6nxnE4XoZLAPw0is-bv_Ai6xHthMkrxrFfJiNyvPbhmJz07u21ERa/4v8/7wnjw8ERQdWxc52KsUXU_A/h2/h001.VNNv_8zfQebZgSZbSGd8mIQ47fwaFxv6z842AAAgQAg)
Together, let’s make our government answer to our communities.
-OnePA

Hi, it's Jon Ossoff.
I'm the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won. And this U.S. Senate race in Georgia will be one of the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
So if you're upset by what's being done to our country right now and you're ready to fight back, please chip in what you can to support my campaign here in Georgia.
**Here 's the link to donate: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-fr-substack-2026](https://substack.com/redirect/c830eae0-cd42-4ae6-bc55-d6e57dc15fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for the Senate -- and why this moment is even more urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump's rise wasn't just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible. We defeated him, and I won.
But now returned to power, this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:
* He's freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists -- and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Threatened to take news broadcasters off the air unless they met his demands for more favorable news coverage.
* And even called for elected Democrats to be EXECUTED.

**This is not a drill and it 's not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.**
In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn't be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history -- and _we won._ That victory won the Senate majority.
Now we must win again. And _we will win again._
Just like last time, I can't do it alone.
So I'm asking:
**[Please make a contribution to my reelection campaign today, of any amount that works for you.](https://substack.com/redirect/c830eae0-cd42-4ae6-bc55-d6e57dc15fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute today.
[CONTRIBUTE](https://substack.com/redirect/c830eae0-cd42-4ae6-bc55-d6e57dc15fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks for being part of this team.
As always,
Jon Ossoff

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: “Give us another chance”? You have to be kidding me.
body:
When someone shows you who they are, believe them.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261027-3.wO5DvN&refcode=em20261027-2205&%3Bamount=5&t=1&akid=2205%2E1086043%2E0MXz31)
**_ “Give us another chance.” – JD Vance_**
Peter, that was JD Vance’s official sales pitch to voters all across the country.
When I heard those words, I immediately thought of what Maya Angelou said: _When someone shows you who they are, believe them._
Trump and Vance told us they would bring down costs. Instead, costs have skyrocketed because of their corruption and incompetence.
They told us they would end the wars. Today? We’re stuck in a _brand new_ war of choice they have no clue how to get out of.

No sugarcoating this, Team:**ProPublica data analysis shows that delays resulting from the U.S. Postal Service’s cost-cutting measures have endangered the validity of ballots cast in rural areas across the country.** We've been warning everyone all year that the USPS postmark changes -- namely your mail getting stamped the day it hits a _regional processing facility_ , not at your local post office -- would make it harder to vote and result in ballots not being counted. ProPublica's reporting found documented proof this is happening. In rural Washington state, for example, thousands of ballots were delivered late and not counted. In fact, 1n the 11 predominately rural counties in eastern Washington state, there was nearly a 250% increase in ballots delivered late as compared to 2022's midterm primary, before these postmark changes.
