clean_body: ProPublica: Ballot Rejections Soared in Rural Counties After USPS Reduced Mail Service| | | | | | = No sugarcoating this, Team:ProPublica data analysis shows that delays resulting from the U.S. Postal Service’s cost-cutting measures have endangered the validity of ballots cast in rural areas across the country. We've been warning everyone all year that the USPS postmark changes -- namely your mail getting stamped the day it hits a regional processing facility , not at your local post office -- would make it harder to vote and result in ballots not being counted. ProPublica's reporting found documented proof this is happening. In rural Washington state, for example, thousands of ballots were delivered late and not counted. In fact, 1n the 11 predominately rural counties in eastern Washington state, there was nearly a 250% increase in ballots delivered late as compared to 2022's midterm primary, before these postmark changes. Listen, we're still trying to reach every voter we can with this information to get them to drop their ballot in an election dropbox or have them ask to have their ballot postmarked in front of them at a post office. But we need your help to keep reaching mail-in voters across the country. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | | = | | = | | = | | | We all should be worried about every mail-in voter getting their ballot in on time , but especially those most vulnerable to these changes, like the elderly, rural Americans who live far from USPS regional facilities, our military service members, and young people who are voting by mail away from home. Simply put, no voters deserve to be disenfranchised from our elections over DOGE's cost-cutting measures or conspiracies and lies about mail-in ballots.We hope you can help us spread the word about these USPS postmark changes to your friends, family, and colleagues. Hey Peter, I sat down with the Paris Post-Intelligencer to talk about something that’s at the heart of how I lead: listening.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/KNnbDob7AnP3Gs4P7TqZwA~~/AAUS1hA~/WzY3KLVEXyJG_BO67lcXvcGqtV33setFK9_thk8Sw03u-SM-wNmon-F2dEPOP1Y9BXdtwRJD2Z9Yoq3tWOLRBH0m3miolZ5aUxG7HyrZS8vxvrz5LCY2eF9-WJvpuFhU4Gq4Hu-DQUJGe1fAbwUAHUX0c2VCEexzqEhs1W7YyntRyhMRJKjHeya7pg_MJohJfxeyIGCa3AYE-_wL3DPd14dvoN6qM4Zm4R76hk6jxIV4SBZ8ia8RQExOB_yDvw7ImsuD_FcPC58Sn2uR4-LpeOl6zPiC4WbmESSBkR7AuAx0KWzKugiEmonpJcvwaxnnMs9bbfIv3BjhjPgSbz9pKv03H8SZktNhTFR3LzkEWhU~)
For over a year now, we’ve traveled the 17 counties of TN-05 to hear directly from the folks who live here. A couple weeks ago, that took us to Paris, TN, where I got to chat with some of the loveliest people you’ll ever meet. Every stop reminds me that the best ideas in this district don’t come from Washington. They come from the people I’m asking to represent.
It’s been the honor of a lifetime to hear from you. I take your concerns seriously, and I’m committed to carrying your voices with me to Congress.

name: Matt at Swing Left
subject: One last push for Ground Truth buses
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
This program is making a real difference.
#
Hi there,
I wanted to reach out to say thank you. Thanks to the incredible generosity of the Swing Left community, we’ve raised over $100,000 this year to secure 33 Ground Truth buses.
Those buses have already transported hundreds of volunteers from blue cities like New York, San Francisco, and Chicago to talk with voters in neighboring swing districts and states where control of Congress will be decided in next Tuesday’s midterm election.
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&utm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=gt-buses-2026&%3Butm_content=20261027-2&%3Brefcode=ak_em_gt-buses-2026_20261027-2&t=1&akid=3314%2E1562180%2EY4RWHb)
This program is making a real difference. Every bus means more doors knocked and more conversations with voters. Some of the House and Senate races that will decide which party will be in the majority for the next two years are expected to be close, and every conversation matters. Over the last several weekends, buses have been filling up, and we’ve been hearing from Swing Left volunteers who are eager to have a bus in their city.
**That’s why today, we’re announcing 12 _new_ Ground Truth buses that will be transporting volunteers to swing districts this weekend.**
With just one weekend left to get out the vote, we really want to go all out and do everything we can to make sure voters turn out for Democrats.
Each bus costs about $3,000, which means we need to raise $36,000 to cover the costs for the 12 new buses we’ve secured for this weekend.
[**If you’d like to help, consider making a donation to the Ground Truth Bus Fund today. It’s one of the best ways to support the volunteers who are doing the work to turn out voters in this final weekend before Election Day.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&utm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=gt-buses-2026&%3Butm_content=20261027-2&%3Brefcode=ak_em_gt-buses-2026_20261027-2&t=2&akid=3314%2E1562180%2EY4RWHb)
**[Donate $25 »](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&amount=25&utm_source=ak&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=gt-buses-2026&utm_content=20261027-2&refcode=ak_em_gt-buses-2026_20261027-2&t=22&akid=3314%2E1562180%2EY4RWHb)**
Thank you again for your support. We couldn’t do _any_ of this work without this incredible community!
Matt Caffrey
Senior Organizing Director, Swing Left

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261027-2&t=23&refcode2=3314_1562180_Y4RWHb&akid=3314%2E1562180%2EY4RWHb)

This number decides how many voters hear from us in the final week. | | | | Derek, I’ve been on the road on our bus tour these past few days, but I wanted you to hear this from me: My fight for the Wisconsin governor’s seat will come down to the numbers, and at this point, I’m concerned it won’t add up to a win: → **9%** of voters still undecided
→ **1 point** apart in the polls
→ **$34M** in MAGA billionaire “donations”
→ **2.5-to-1** spending advantage for Tiffany
→ **7 days** until Election Day The only way we’ll win this race is with massive grassroots support. I can’t be in every living room in Wisconsin, and TV ads are how we reach the voters I can’t get to in person.
Here’s the thing: 9% of voters are still undecided, early voting is already open, and Congressman Tom Tiffany is flooding the airwaves with ugly and untrue attack ads.
He has $34 million from 2 far-right billionaire families to keep them running through Election Day.
**I don’t have that. I have you, and thousands of grassroots supporters across Wisconsin.**
With 7 days left, money now beats money later.
A dollar that comes in this week buys airtime we can use. If we fall short of this budget, some of the ads we planned won’t run, and Tiffany’s ads will go unanswered in the last few days.
Even $3 helps. **[Will you chip in to my campaign and Battleground Wisconsin before midnight to help us stay on the air to reach undecided voters through Election Day?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquchf2e3e-bIm5hAkq2zKIjvamPfag9y_bswSQjaYCFy4sKpZevmYpX56N35pCjuPNuFsSeMqWqV_fFYEd5K3B-C6-Ksmu-P_vDUubfsn2Wm6usxI26V-2tP8iIL2GG2PMqPAfwaeU42MWzFXs6vGdqcYmvpX0LoIkOgluSuclhI3__GkbyEu4zW8IQwK5bN7EJL2H9GEkG417Ct1Siu_veUqJucm3dX2ddh0ks6J0wVLzoQyNNKXBu7D_zBcL5zvZuFTMnt2fgO0829ZHz-RiS9MSK2ucq7TTbFNXDPvXDb_ogAw6PzQOxjHrCm-A83I9KkQcUziL4FqoGrFzxjj8J2Y4YpgHJuuZACbim37aqTwKYW-yKc1jMwvwUGAEE_omCfcfB1dyr2xX-PworJ9KjDarXIBecoZmPtmKMzgAqQg/4v8/cvpWiGJ8QOysFS9MsipaVg/h7/h001.SI8yTQfAjX67niGF4Oh-shX9fUrhv4tSggO3EIKOqdU)**

It’s why our movement hit the road for a 10 day, 40 stop tour. | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately: | | | | | | I can’t be in every living room in Wisconsin, and TV ads are how we reach the voters I can’t get to in person. Here’s the thing: 9% of voters are still undecided, early voting is already open, and Congressman Tom Tiffany is flooding the airwaves with ugly and untrue attack ads. He has $34 million from 2 far-right billionaire families to keep them running through Election Day. I don’t have that. I have you, and thousands of grassroots supporters across Wisconsin. With 7 days left, money now beats money later. A dollar that comes in this week buys airtime we can use. body:
We’re all in for this last week, and we hope you are too. |
---

| | | | There’s just one week left before Election Day!
| |
---
Lizzie and the team have been covering a lot of ground in #TX07 and across our community, connecting with voters and working to turn out Texans. We’ve been knocking on doors, making calls, and turning voters into volunteers.
From Midtown to Asiatown, across Harris and Fort Bend counties, #TeamLizzie has teamed up with friends and partners throughout the district to get voters to the polls. Just last weekend, we had another big Get Out the Vote Weekend of Action.
In Harris County, we hit the streets with Texas Together, Staci Childs, and Dr. Darlene Breaux, knocking on doors and talking to voters in Alief and Southwest Houston. On Sunday, we also joined in the joy of voting at Praise to the Polls!

|
---
In Fort Bend County, we joined forces with Dexter McCoy, Jon Rosenthal, and Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi who came all the way from Illinois to remind Texans about the stakes in this election for us and for the entire country.
|
---

This Wednesday at 8:00 PM, I'll debate Maggie Goodlander live on WMUR. Here's my prediction: she'll stick to the same old party talking points, and I'll spend the night laying out my plan to lower your costs. I trust you to be the judge.

Nine days. Let's leave everything on the field.
THIS PAST WEEK...
# **I WON THE NEW ENGLAND COLLEGE DEBATE!**
In Henniker, I went head to head with Maggie Goodlander, and I came with plans, not talking points.

When the moderators asked how I'd bring down the cost of healthcare, I laid it out: [Watch my one-minute answer here.](https://us.list-manage.com/EW0O9qWF0Og?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

Thank you to everyone who [stood out with me on the Henniker common](https://us.list-manage.com/14D5wPYx4XQ?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c) beforehand!
# **KEENE STATE, NASHUA & THE SUPER CHASE**
On Wednesday, I [took questions from students at Keene State](https://us.list-manage.com/fd0uKrBpOm2?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c), because young people especially deserve to be heard.

On Thursday, Granite Staters filled my 10th "Ask Me Anything" Town Hall at Nashua Community College, and [here's what a few of them had to say](https://us.list-manage.com/Z1Z8AeZLzsC?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c).

On Saturday, Team Lily [hit the doors with Turning Point Action's Super Chase](https://us.list-manage.com/ZLcLWfCzISV?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c) in Newport and Nashua.

# 9 DAYS TO GO...
**DEBATE NIGHT**

# **WEDNESDAY 10/28, 8:00 PM - WATCH MY WMUR DEBATE**
This is the big one: my debate against Maggie Goodlander, live on WMUR, in front of the whole state. Wherever you are in the country, you can watch it with me.

**[WATCH LIVE ON WMUR.COM](https://us.list-manage.com/thF44unqo15?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)**
(or on WMUR News 9 in New Hampshire)

**Then help me spread the word.** Many Granite Staters are still making up their minds. If you know anyone in New Hampshire, send them the debate and ask them to be the judge. A text from someone they trust goes further than any ad. **IN NEW HAMPSHIRE? JOIN ME IN MANCHESTER.**
Wave signs with me outside WMUR, 100 S Commercial St. Please arrive by 4:45 PM, before the 5:45 sunset. [RSVP here](https://us.list-manage.com/tzFRLdxAmvE?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c) for all the details.

Pete Hegseth's proposed livestream of an execution may have been shut down after righteous backlash sounded from around the country. As a retired general, I can tell you that the military carries out its most difficult missions with dignity, respect, and a quiet discipline that honors those who serve. Pete Hegseth thinks it's okay to turn it into a horrific reality TV show, and that's downright disgraceful--and it says more than he might realize about his ability to do his job. Take this _New York Times_ headline.
---

As the article goes on to say: **_" Men with real accomplishments on the battlefield don't tend to talk this way."_** After 40 years in uniform, I couldn't agree more. This job is simply too big for Pete Hegseth to handle. Discipline, judgment, and accountability are not optional in military leadership. Hegseth has shown none of them. His amateurism is endangering our troops and making America less safe. **He needs to be fired -- and Clay Fuller can't be trusted to do it.** Our troops deserve far better from their leader, and they deserve far better from the members of Congress who refuse to hold that leader accountable. It's time to send someone to Congress who will stand up for our troops even when it's not politically convenient -- someone who will demand more from leadership and take real action to make it happen. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142325890/656547715/-373287771?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_261027_FR_Omelette_A0_na_U1_X2_M4&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODFkNjQ3MS02MGQyLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJkNTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_D8fOVNrf_52QwReagEh6_yM5NL0XR1DWcFdCmFubag=) More than anything, I want to get back to Congress so I can do more good work for the people of Hampton Roads. That’s easier said than done, because winning an ultra-competitive, top-targeted, frontline battleground district takes a whole lot of energy, hard work, and cash. (Trust me, I’ve done it twice.) The deadline is fast approaching -- and our baby girl is leading the charge [to make a difference](https://substack.com/redirect/d6c15e5f-15b4-44a0-99e0-486b40750f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the lives of children.
She is an elite athlete -- training six days a week. She takes honors and AP classes and has worked hard to maintain her 4.43 GPA. She's disciplined, kind, and focused -- the kind of young woman who believes hard work and heart can change the world.
Click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/d6c15e5f-15b4-44a0-99e0-486b40750f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to donate.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6c15e5f-15b4-44a0-99e0-486b40750f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hear from Kayla yourself...
###### **Hello Friends and Family!**
I am honored to serve as the Mini-THON Captain for the Games and Rules Committee, where I get to combine my love for bringing people together with a cause that means so much to me: helping kids conquer childhood cancer through [Four Diamonds Mini-THON](https://substack.com/redirect/d6c15e5f-15b4-44a0-99e0-486b40750f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
What I love most about Mini-THON is seeing how something as simple as coming together as a community can make such a lasting difference in a child's life. My school and every committee work tirelessly throughout the year, dedicating countless hours to fundraising, planning, and creating an unforgettable night for our students and Four Diamonds families. Together, we have raised over **$2 MILLION** in the past 20 years, and I am so proud to be part of a tradition that continues to grow.
Every dollar I help raise supports Four Diamonds' life-saving research to better prevent, diagnose, treat, and ultimately cure childhood cancer. Beyond research, I am proud to help ensure that every Four Diamonds child, regardless of their family's income, receives the highest quality childhood cancer care without ever having to see a bill for that care.
Since 1972, Four Diamonds has supported more than 4,800 children and their families. Being able to play even a small role in that mission is something I truly value. Mini-THON has shown me that making a difference does not always require doing something extraordinary--it can start with simply showing up, caring deeply, and bringing others together for a cause bigger than yourself.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/d6c15e5f-15b4-44a0-99e0-486b40750f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you! :-)
